Title: Están todos bien
Stars: Marcello Mastroianni, Michèle Morgan, Valeria Cavalli
Description: Matteo se embarca en un viaje por Italia para visitar a sus cinco hijos.

Title: El primer día del resto de tu vida
Stars: Jacques Gamblin, Zabou Breitman, Déborah François
Description: Five key days in a family's life.

Title: Depuis qu'Otar est parti...
Stars: Esther Gorintin, Nino Khomasuridze, Dinara Drukarova
Description: The one joy in the lives of a mother and daughter comes from the regular letters sent to them from Paris from the family's adored son, Otar. When the daughter finds out that Otar has died suddenly, she tries to conceal the truth from her mother, changing the course of their lives forever.

Title: Po semeynym obstoyatelstvam
Stars: Galina Polskikh, Yevgeniya Khanayeva, Evgeniy Evstigneev
Description: Varias historias de amor en torno a una familia joven, incluidos los padres de los recién casados e incluso la abuela.

Title: Agosto
Stars: Meryl Streep, Julia Roberts, Chris Cooper
Description: Una mirada a las vidas de las determinadas mujeres de la familia Weston, quienes regresan a Oklahoma con motivo de una crisis familiar.

Title: El juez
Stars: Robert Downey Jr., Robert Duvall, Vera Farmiga
Description: El abogado de la gran ciudad, Hank Palmer, regresa a la casa de su infancia, donde su padre, el juez del pueblo, es sospechoso de asesinato. Hank se propone descubrir la verdad y, por el camino, se reencuentra con su familia distanciada.

Title: Pequeña Miss Sunshine
Stars: Valerie Faris, Abigail Breslin, Greg Kinnear, Paul Dano
Description: Una familia decidida a llevar a su hija pequeña a la final de un concurso de belleza emprende un viaje en furgoneta a través del país.

Title: Junebug
Stars: Embeth Davidtz, David Kuhn, Alessandro Nivola
Description: Un comerciante de arte viaja de Chicago a Carolina del Norte para conocer a sus nuevos suegros, desafiando el equilibrio de esta casa sureña de clase media.

Title: Deti Don-Kikhota
Stars: Anatoliy Papanov, Vera Orlova, Natalya Fateeva
Description: The head of maternity clinic is nicknamed Don Quixote by his neighbors. He spends days and nights with newborn children, forgetting about his own growing sons.

Title: Padre e hijos
Stars: Philippe Noiret, Charles Berling, Bruno Putzulu
Description: An old man comes up with a subterfuge to reconcile his estranged sons.

Title: El Juego de Zucker
Stars: Henry Hübchen, Hannelore Elsner, Udo Samel
Description: A Journalist of Jewish descent in Berlin feels that he is a loser of the political changes in Germany after 1989. When his mother dies, he has to meet his brother to whom he has not talked for years and to meet all his other family members. But during the preparations for the funeral he plays a snooker-cup for paying his debts with the money for the victory, and many other things mixes up.

Title: Mayrig
Stars: Claudia Cardinale, Omar Sharif, Nathalie Roussel
Description: The saga of an Armenian family that immigrated to France after the break-up of the oppressive Ottoman Empire.

Title: Hatuna Meuheret
Stars: Lior Ashkenazi, Ronit Elkabetz, Moni Moshonov
Description: Torn between family expectations to marry a virgin bride and his love for divorced mom Judith, 31-year-old Zaza navigates traditional matchmaking while hiding his true feelings.

Title: Still Walking
Stars: Hiroshi Abe, Yui Natsukawa, You
Description: Una familia se reúne para un ritual conmemorativo cuya naturaleza solo se aclara gradualmente.

Title: La familia
Stars: Emanuele Lamaro, Andrea Occhipinti, Vittorio Gassman
Description: With the background of the XX century Italian history, Carlo, a retired teacher, traces the vicissitudes of his family.

Title: Matrimonio a la italiana
Stars: Sophia Loren, Marcello Mastroianni, Aldo Puglisi
Description: El rico Doménico y Filomena, una prostituta sin dinero, comparten gran parte de sus vidas en la Italia inmediatamente posterior a la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

Title: Dolgie provody
Stars: Zinaida Sharko, Oleg Vladimirsky, Yuriy Kayurov
Description: A single mother is confused by the changes in her teenage son, who has become distant since spending summer vacation with his father.

Title: Mamma Roma
Stars: Anna Magnani, Ettore Garofolo, Franco Citti
Description: Habiendo renunciado a su ignominioso pasado, una ex prostituta se reencuentra con su hijo.

Title: Nochnye zabavy
Stars: Valeriy Uskov, Evgeniy Evstigneev, Aleksandra Kolkunova, Irina Alfyorova
Description: The husband is a subordinate. The lover is the boss. And the "wise" adult daughter, who is trying to save her father's reputation and catch her mother, drawing an unfamiliar restaurant saxophonist into this farce.

Title: Papa
Stars: Vladimir Mashkov, Egor Beroev, Andrei Rozendent
Description: This film derives from A. Galych's play, "Matrosskaya Tishina," "Papa" tells a story of a Jewish father who dreams of seeing his son perform on stage in front of huge audiences, dreams of seeing him as the greatest violinist of his time. To achieve this goal, he teaches his son Dodik how to play the violin from an early age. When Dodik grows up he leaves the small town he and his father lived in to study in the Moscow Conservatory, leaving his past behind. But one day he has to choose either to lose his father or everything he has achieved.

Title: S lyubimymi ne rasstavaytes
Stars: Irina Alfyorova, Aleksandr Abdulov, Lyudmila Drebnyova
Description: Mitya stops believing his wife Katya. He is tormented, tormented by jealousy, despite the fact that his wife did not cheat. They are getting divorced. Shortly after the divorce, Katya ends up in the hospital. Quiet, with dull eyes, Mitya visits her. Their date is coming to an end. And suddenly she screams, choking with sobs: "I miss you, Mitya!" Suspicions, doubts, jealousy - everything is gone. Only love remained - real, all-consuming, subjected to a cruel test and rediscovered itself.

Title: Ty u menya odna
Stars: Aleksandr Zbruev, Mark Goronok, Marina Neyolova
Description: Listening to the sweet sound of the song "You are the only one" Eugene can't choose which shore to join - America or Russia.

Title: Quemado por el sol
Stars: Oleg Menshikov, Nikita Mikhalkov, Ingeborga Dapkunaite
Description: En la Unión Soviética de 1936, la sombra de las represiones de Stalin se cierne sobre un famoso héroe de la revolución.

Title: ¿A quién ama Gilbert Grape?
Stars: Johnny Depp, Leonardo DiCaprio, Juliette Lewis
Description: Después de la muerte de su padre, Gilbert tiene que cuidar a su hermano con discapacidad mental, Arnie, y a su madre con obesidad mórbida. Sin embargo, esta situación se pone en tela de juicio de repente, cuando el amor entra en su vida de forma inesperada.

Title: Aberdeen
Stars: Stellan Skarsgård, Lena Headey, Jean Johansson
Description: A mom dying in Aberdeen, Scotland, asks her coke snorting, nympho, London lawyer daughter to get her estranged, alcoholic dad in Oslo, Norway, to Aberdeen. He's drunk at the airport, so they travel together by car and ferry.

Title: La balada de Jack y Rose
Stars: Camilla Belle, Daniel Day-Lewis, Catherine Keener
Description: Un padre y una hija aislados en una isla de la costa este y que viven en una comuna que antiguamente era próspera se enfrentan a los límites de la familia y la sexualidad.

Title: Sin anestesia
Stars: Zbigniew Zapasiewicz, Ewa Dalkowska, Andrzej Seweryn
Description: A famous Polish journalist presents a problem for the powers-that-be when he displays his full political skill and knowledge on a television show featuring questions and answers on a world conference by a panel of journalists. His enemies take away his privileges when he is away. The shock of being "unwanted" parallels a deeper disappointment in his private life: his wife has an affair with a jealous young rival, and after 15 years of marriage and two daughters wants a divorce. She offers no explanations as he tries to untie these problems himself. All the moves he makes are the wrong ones. He takes on drinking heavily with students eager to attend his seminar after discovering the class has been canceled. The journalist, once suave and commanding is reduced to silence.

Title: El bosque de los abedules
Stars: Daniel Olbrychski, Olgierd Lukaszewicz, Emilia Krakowska
Description: A musician tries to find his inner peace in a cottage within the woods.

Title: Bolshaya semya
Stars: Sergei Lukyanov, Boris Andreyev, Vera Kuznetsova
Description: An epic of the Zhurbin family of shipbuilders, spanning several generations.

Title: Vassa
Stars: Inna Churikova, Vadim Mikhaylov, Nikolai Skorobogatov
Description: Ruthless millionaire Vassa Zheleznova is the head of a wealthy entrepreneurial family. She can do anything to protect its reputation, even push her husband to suicide.

Title: Dilber'in Sekiz Günü
Stars: Nesrin Cavadzade, Firat Tanis, Osman Akca
Description: Dilber lives with her family in a very poor eastern village, her only dream is to marry her childhood lover, Ali. But when she finds out that it won't happen because of a reason that she can't get away with, she gets crazy and lock herself up in her family's barn.

Title: La isla desnuda
Stars: Nobuko Otowa, Taiji Tonoyama, Shinji Tanaka
Description: Una familia de cuatro miembros son los únicos habitantes de una pequeña isla, donde luchan cada día para regar sus cultivos.

Title: Children of Heaven
Stars: Reza Naji, Amir Farrokh Hashemian, Bahare Seddiqi
Description: Los zapatos de Zohres se han perdido; su hermano mayor Ali se los perdió. Son pobres, no hay zapatos para Zohre..... hasta que apareció una idea: compartirán un par de zapatos, La escuela de Alis,espera. ¿Logrará el plan?

Title: La casa en la que vivo
Stars: Yakov Segel, Valentina Telegina, Nikolai Yelizarov, Vladimir Zemlyanikin
Description: A film about war from the point of view of those left behind.

Title: Fang xiang zhi lu
Stars: Wei Fan, Lu Huang, Hongyi Li
Description: Aboard a bus in the rural mountains of China, a naive young girl name Li Chunfen attends to passengers' needs, all the while speaking of the virtues of the Communist Party. The always loyal Li is happy to serve the driver, Old Cui, a kind of father figure to her who also acts as the consoling voice of the party. When she develops an acute case of puppy love for a frequent passenger -- an emotion that leads to a chased kiss and a rape report, she learns all too well that her party and driver might not always have her best interests in mind. But how big of hand will the Cultural Revolution play in Li's life? How much control will she have over her own fate? Spanning five decades of Li's life, The Road is a coming-of-age tale of epic proportions. Heartbreakingly beautiful -- the countryside cinematography is jaw-dropping -- and tragically timely, the film stands out as a masterful work from a powerful new Chinese voice, director Zhang Jiarui, reminding us of a painful history and warning us never to repeat it.

Title: Revolutionary Road
Stars: Kate Winslet, Leonardo DiCaprio, Christopher Fitzgerald
Description: Una joven pareja que vive en un barrio de Connecticut a mediados de la década de 1950 lucha por resolver sus problemas personales mientras tratan de criar a sus dos hijos.

Title: Doch
Stars: Natalya Nazarova, Mariya Smolnikova, Yana Dubuis, Igor Mazepa
Description: Inna conoce a dos recién llegados a su pequeño pueblo: su promiscua compañera de clase Masha y el hijo del sacerdote Ilya. El pueblo es tristemente célebre por un asesino en serie cuyas víctimas son adolescentes supuestamente indecentes.

Title: ¡Vivir!
Stars: You Ge, Gong Li, Ben Niu
Description: Después de que Fugui y Jiazhen pierdan sus fortunas personales, forman una familia y sobreviven a los difíciles cambios culturales de la China de los años cuarenta a setenta.

Title: La habitación de Marvin
Stars: Meryl Streep, Leonardo DiCaprio, Diane Keaton
Description: Tras 20 años cuidando a su padre, una mujer con cáncer debe volver a contactar con su odiosa hermana y su sobrino, que no ha visto desde su diagnóstico. Su amor ayuda al rebelde sobrino y su hermana aprende a relacionarse con los demás.

Title: El gato
Stars: Jean Gabin, Simone Signoret, Annie Cordy
Description: En 1971, en Courbevoie (Francia), el antiguo tipógrafo Julien Bouin y su esposa Clemence, apenas se hablan. Para enfado de Clemence, el gato de Julien, Greffier, es el único que recibe su atención, por no hablar de su amor.

Title: La gata sobre el tejado de zinc
Stars: Elizabeth Taylor, Paul Newman, Burl Ives
Description: Brick es un exfutbolista alcohólico que se pasa los días bebiendo y se resiste a los afectos de su mujer. El reencuentro con su padre, en estado terminal, provoca una serie de recuerdos y revelaciones tanto para el padre como para el hijo.

Title: Kramer contra Kramer
Stars: Dustin Hoffman, Meryl Streep, Jane Alexander
Description: Después de que su esposa lo deje, un ejecutivo publicitario de Manhattan obsesionado con el trabajo debe aprender habilidades de paternidad olvidadas, pero la batalla por la custodia de su hijo profundiza las heridas de la separación.

Title: American Beauty
Stars: Kevin Spacey, Annette Bening, Thora Birch
Description: Un padre de clase media sexualmente frustrado sufre una crisis de los 40 tras enamorarse de la mejor amiga de su hija.

Title: Una familia con clase
Stars: Jessica Biel, Ben Barnes, Kristin Scott Thomas
Description: Un joven inglés se casa con una estadounidense glamorosa. Cuando él la lleva a casa para conocer a los padres, ella llega como una explosión del futuro, sacando por la ventana su arraigada congestión británica.

Title: Belle maman
Stars: Catherine Deneuve, Vincent Lindon, Mathilde Seigner
Description: On his wedding day, Antoine falls madly in love with Léa, his mother-in-law.

Title: Amor
Stars: Lili Darvas, Mari Töröcsik, Iván Darvas
Description: The wife of a political prisoner tends to her mother-in-law and keeps from the old woman the truth about her son, whom she believes is in New York making a film.

Title: Amor
Stars: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Emmanuelle Riva, Isabelle Huppert
Description: Georges y Anne con una pareja octogenaría. Cuando Anne sufre un infarto, su vínculo de amor es puesto a prueba.

Title: Lyubov i golubi
Stars: Aleksandr Mikhaylov, Nina Doroshina, Lyudmila Gurchenko
Description: Injured on the job Vasily Kuzyakin gets a ticket to the resort. There he meets femme fatale Raisa Zakharovna, and once under the charm, moves to live with her. Unfortunately, a new life is not all that sweet as dreamed hapless Vasily.

Title: Martha
Stars: Margit Carstensen, Karlheinz Böhm, Barbara Valentin
Description: Tras la muerte de su padre, un abusador, Marta, una bibliotecaria solitaria, se casa con un hombre igualmente despreciable: Helmut.

Title: Mother
Stars: Kim Hye-ja, Won Bin, Jin Goo
Description: Una madre busca desesperadamente al asesino que incriminó a su hijo en la muerte de una chica.

Title: Machekha
Stars: Tatyana Doronina, Leonid Nevedomsky, Nadezhda Fedosova
Description: The news suddenly comes to the family of Pavel Olevantsev that his daughter has been orphaned by another woman. Pavel did not know about the existence of the girl, and his wife could not know about it either.

Title: Obyasneniye v lyubvi
Stars: Ewa Szykulska, Yuriy Bogatyryov, Angelina Stepanova
Description: The life of Filipok, a young man with a romantic personality, which happens in the first half of the 20th century in Soviet Russia. Filipok finds love with a young women, Zinochka who is of aristocratic roots.

Title: Mirando hacia atrás con ira
Stars: Richard Burton, Claire Bloom, Mary Ure
Description: Un licenciado universitario decepcionado y airado intenta reconciliarse con el rencor que siente hacia la vida y los valores de la clase media.

Title: Odnazhdy dvadtsat let spustya
Stars: Natalya Gundareva, Evgeniy Lazarev, Oleg Efremov
Description: After 20 years classmates get together and discuss their unfulfilled dreams and unmet goals.

Title: Sonata de otoño
Stars: Ingrid Bergman, Liv Ullmann, Lena Nyman
Description: Una hija casada que anhela el amor de su madre recibe la visita de esta, una exitosa concertista de piano.

Title: Para gnedykh
Stars: Irina Kupchenko, Mikhail Zhigalov, Agniya Kuznetsova
Description: For the summer, a granddaughter, a student Irina, comes to her grandmother Lydia Petrovna, who lives by the sea. There is a difficult relationship between them: they rarely see each other, since Irina's father (Lydia Petrovna's son) died a long time ago, and the relationship between the daughter-in-law and mother-in-law did not work out from the very beginning. At first glance, grandmother and granddaughter are very different. Irina is amused by the old-fashioned delicacy of Lydia Petrovna, and that, in turn, worries about the directness of her granddaughter. But gradually a spiritual closeness and mutual understanding arise between them, and the granddaughter begins to change under the influence of her grandmother.

Title: Pelle el Conquistador
Stars: Pelle Hvenegaard, Max von Sydow, Erik Paaske
Description: Cuando muere su esposa, Lasse se lleva a su hijo de 12 años, Pelle, de su casa en Suecia a Dinamarca en busca de una vida mejor.

Title: Pather Panchali (La canción del camino)
Stars: Kanu Bannerjee, Karuna Bannerjee, Chunibala Devi
Description: Apu y su familia viven en la pobreza. Su padre Harihar sueña con una vida mejor para su familia y emprende un viaje fuera de su pueblo en Bengal para buscar trabajo. Pero en su ausencia ocurre una tragedia.

Title: Los descendientes
Stars: George Clooney, Shailene Woodley, Amara Miller
Description: Un terrateniente intenta contactar con sus hijas después de que su esposa resultara gravemente herida en un accidente de navegación.

Title: El nido de Adán
Stars: Inna Churikova, Yelena Bogdanova, Svetlana Ryabova
Description: A tragicomedy about four women of three generations living in a small Moscow flat: a sick grandmother who needs attention; a mother who cannot manage her personal life; and two daughters, each of whom have their own challenges.

Title: Pregi
Stars: Michal Zebrowski, Jan Frycz, Agnieszka Grochowska
Description: Wiktor, who was mistreated by his father as a child, is now a tormented grown-up. He meets beautiful Tania and wants to settle down but it's not easy to get rid of childhood traumas.

Title: S vechera do poludnya
Stars: Vsevolod Sanaev, Leonid Filatov, Lyudmila Saveleva

Title: Bellísima
Stars: Anna Magnani, Walter Chiari, Tina Apicella
Description: A woman from the lower class desperately tries to get her daughter into the movies.

Title: Crónica familiar
Stars: Marcello Mastroianni, Jacques Perrin, Sylvie
Description: A man recalls the life of his late younger brother.

Title: Asuntos de familia
Stars: Andy Garcia, Julianna Margulies, Steven Strait
Description: El guardia de la prisión, Vince le dice a Molly de la clase de actuación, que un recluso tiene 24 años.

Title: Smrt krásných srncu
Stars: Karel Hermánek, Rudolf Hrusínský, Jirí Krampol
Description: During World War II, Leo Popper, a travel agent traveling across the country to sell vacuum cleaners, loses his job, for the sole fault of being Jewish. When his two sons are sent to the camp, in order to provide them food for the road, the poor father is forced to kill a deer, a being he considered sacred.

Title: Starshiy syn
Stars: Evgeniy Leonov, Natalya Egorova, Vladimir Izotov
Description: Late for the last commuter train and reluctant to spend the night outdoors, two young men trick a family into letting them stay in their apartment: one of them insists that he's the illegitimate son of the man who owns the apartment.

Title: Staryy novyy god
Stars: Oleg Efremov, Vyacheslav Nevinnyy, Aleksandr Kalyagin, Kseniya Minina
Description: Two men, sharing the same first name and living in the same building but each with different background and attitude to life, have to rethink their views in the midst of crowded winter holiday celebration.

Title: Entre nosotros
Stars: Lars Eidinger, Birgit Minichmayr, Hans-Jochen Wagner
Description: Durante unas vacaciones en el Mediterráneo, una pareja aparentemente feliz ve cómo se pone a prueba su relación cuando conocen a otra pareja.

Title: La vergüenza
Stars: Liv Ullmann, Max von Sydow, Sigge Fürst
Description: Jan y Eva Rosenberg, dos antiguos violinistas con un matrimonio tempestuoso, dirigen una granja en una isla en plena guerra civil. A pesar de haberlo intentado todo para huir de su patria, la guerra interfiere en todos los aspectos de sus vidas.

Title: Secretos de un matrimonio
Stars: Liv Ullmann, Erland Josephson, Bibi Andersson
Description: "Escenas de un matrimonio" narra los muchos años de amor y crisis que vinculan a Marianne y Johan a lo largo del matrimonio, la infidelidad, el divorcio y sus posteriores parejas.

Title: La felicidad
Stars: Jean-Claude Drouot, Claire Drouot, Olivier Drouot
Description: François, un joven carpintero, vive una vida feliz y sin complicaciones con su mujer Thérèse y sus dos hijos. Un día conoce a Emilie en el mostrador de Correos.

Title: El baile de agosto
Stars: Gerard McSorley, Meryl Streep, Michael Gambon
Description: Cinco hermanas solteras aprovechan al máximo su sencilla existencia en la Irlanda rural de los años treinta.

Title: Cuentos de Tokio
Stars: Chishû Ryû, Chieko Higashiyama, Sô Yamamura
Description: Un matrimonio de ancianos viaja a Tokio a visitar a sus hijos pero encuentran indiferencia, ingratitud egoísmo y una marcada diferencia cultural. Cuando los impacientes hijos envían a los ancianos de vuelta a casa, entramos en una profunda reflexión acerca de la mortalidad y la familia.

Title: Tokyo Sonata
Stars: Teruyuki Kagawa, Kyôko Koizumi, Yû Koyanagi
Description: Una familia japonesa común se desintegra lentamente después de que su patriarca pierde su trabajo en una empresa importante.

Title: Celebración
Stars: Ulrich Thomsen, Henning Moritzen, Thomas Bo Larsen
Description: En la fiesta de cumpleaños número 60 de Helge, se revelan algunas verdades familiares desagradables.

Title: Fanny y Alexander
Stars: Kristina Adolphson, Börje Ahlstedt, Pernilla Allwin
Description: Dos jóvenes suecos viven las múltiples comedias y tragedias de su familia, los Ekdahl.

Title: Fantazii Faryateva
Stars: Marina Neyolova, Andrey Mironov, Zinaida Sharko
Description: A funny and sad story of mismatched love, family and life surprises.

Title: El color púrpura
Stars: Danny Glover, Whoopi Goldberg, Margaret Avery
Description: Una mujer negra sureña lucha por encontrar su identidad tras sufrir los abusos de su padre y de otras personas durante cuatro décadas.

Title: Semilla de crisantemo
Stars: Yimou Zhang, Gong Li, Wei Li, Baotian Li
Description: In rural China, the young bride of a tyrannical owner of a silk-dyeing business finds temporary solace in the arms of her husband's nephew, but problems arise when she becomes pregnant.

Title: Hace tanto que te quiero
Stars: Kristin Scott Thomas, Elsa Zylberstein, Serge Hazanavicius
Description: Una mujer hace esfuerzos por integrarse en su familia y su comunidad tras pasar quince años en prisión.

Title: 5x2 (Cinco veces dos)
Stars: Valeria Bruni Tedeschi, Stéphane Freiss, Françoise Fabian
Description: Cinco etapas del romance entre una mujer y un hombre.

Title: Almanya
Stars: Vedat Erincin, Fahri Yardim, Lilay Huser
Description: Después de vivir 45 años en Alemania, el turco Hüseyin Yilmaz, de 70 años, anuncia a su familia que ha comprado una casa en Turquía y que deben volver para hacer las reformas. La idea no es bien recibida y provoca discusiones.

Title: Ana y los lobos
Stars: Geraldine Chaplin, Fernando Fernán Gómez, José María Prada
Description: Una institutriz británica llega a una casa aislada para cuidar a los hijos de una familia complicada.

Title: Se escapó la suerte
Stars: Roger Pigaut, Claire Mafféi, Noël Roquevert
Description: Working class couple Antoine and Antoinette dream of a better life. In the midst of constantly fending off the unwanted attention of men, especially the grocer Monsieur Roland, Antoinette purchases a winning lottery ticket. But when Antoine loses their ticket out of poverty, their dreams seem like they'll remain just that.

Title: Belye rosy
Stars: Vsevolod Sanaev, Nikolay Karachentsov, Mikhail Kokshenov
Description: An old war veteran worries about his three sons - a smart one, a strong one and a kind one.

Title: Una cuestión de tiempo
Stars: Domhnall Gleeson, Rachel McAdams, Bill Nighy
Description: A los 21 años, Tim descubre que puede viajar en el tiempo y cambiar lo que ocurre y ha ocurrido en su propia vida. Su decisión de hacer de su mundo un lugar mejor, consiguiendo una novia, resulta no ser tan fácil como podría pensarse.

Title: Eugenio, un niño sin amor
Stars: Saverio Marconi, Dalila Di Lazzaro, Bernard Blier
Description: The film begins when Eugenio, a 14 year old child, is conduced from his grandparents home outside Rome, to Giancarlo (his father) in the city, by Giancarlo's friend (called "Moustache"). As Eugenio is bothering Moustache, he threatens Eugenio with leaving him in the middle of the country. He finally does it. When Giancarlo finds out, they return for Eugenio, but he is now lost. Meanwhile we're told the story of the child and his relation with the family, and why he feels unwanted.

Title: Viaje a la felicidad de mamá Kusters
Stars: Brigitte Mira, Ingrid Caven, Margit Carstensen
Description: Una pareja marxista convence a la viuda de un obrero de ingresar al partido comunista, donde es utilizada con fines electorales.

Title: Los amantes de María
Stars: Nastassja Kinski, John Savage, Robert Mitchum
Description: Ivan sobrevive a un campo de concentración japonés y regresa a su Pittsburg natal donde reside su amor de juventud, Maria. Se casan, pero esto no pone a un lado los problemas que Ivan ha traído consigo de la guerra.

Title: La octava mujer de Barba Azul
Stars: Claudette Colbert, Gary Cooper, Edward Everett Horton
Description: Después de enterarse de que su prometido multimillonario ya se ha casado siete veces, la hija de un marqués sin dinero decide domarlo.

Title: Vpervye zamuzhem
Stars: Evgeniya Glushenko, Nikolay Volkov, Valentina Telichkina
Description: At the age of 20, Tosya gave birth to a daughter - alone, without a husband. At 30, personal happiness has become an unattainable dream. She devoted herself entirely to her beloved daughter.

Title: Vy ne ostavite menya
Stars: Aleksandr Baluev, Elizaveta Boyarskaya, Aleksandr Adabashyan

Title: Gigante
Stars: Elizabeth Taylor, Rock Hudson, James Dean
Description: Jordan "Bick" Benedict, un joven terrateniente, llega a su inmenso rancho de Texas con su flamante esposa Leslie. No tardan mucho en descubrir que pertenecen a mundos radicalmente opuestos y que los separa un abismo.

Title: Eaux profondes
Stars: Isabelle Huppert, Jean-Louis Trintignant, Sandrine Kljajic
Description: A Melanie le gusta coquetear y tener pequeñas aventuras. Su marido Victor parece soportar sus travesuras con la mayor calma y despreocupación. Esta impresión resulta ser errónea, muy errónea.

Title: Goupi Mains Rouges
Stars: Fernand Ledoux, Georges Rollin, Blanchette Brunoy
Description: En un pueblo perdido de Francia, una anciana es asesinada y le roban sus ahorros. Varios miembros de su familia, todos llamados "Goupi", son sospechosos.

Title: Voces distantes
Stars: Freda Dowie, Pete Postlethwaite, Angela Walsh
Description: The lives of an English working-class family are told out of order in a free-associative manner. The first part, "Distant Voices", focuses on the father's role in the family. The second part, "Still Lives", focuses on his children.

Title: Dvoe i odna
Stars: Georgiy Burkov, Mariya Komarinskaya, Elena Mayorova

Title: Los chicos están bien
Stars: Julianne Moore, Annette Bening, Mark Ruffalo
Description: Dos niños concebidos por inseminación artificial llevan a su padre biológico a conocer su poco habitual vida familiar.

Title: Jude
Stars: Christopher Eccleston, Kate Winslet, Liam Cunningham
Description: En los años 1800 en Inglaterra, Jude planea ir a la ciudad y asistir a la universidad, pero se casa pronto y se convierte en cantero. Cuando su mujer lo abandona, se traslada a la ciudad, donde entabla amistad con su prima liberal Sue.

Title: Días de vino y rosas
Stars: Jack Lemmon, Lee Remick, Charles Bickford
Description: Un alcohólico se casa con una mujer joven a la que hace adicta al alcohol de forma sistemática para que puedan disfrutar juntos de su "pasión".

Title: Bienvenido a la casa de muñecas
Stars: Heather Matarazzo, Victoria Davis, Christina Brucato
Description: Una incómoda alumna de séptimo grado lucha por lidiar con padres distraídos, compañeros de clase esnob, un hermano mayor inteligente, una hermana menor atractiva y sus propias inseguridades.

Title: Larga jornada hacia la noche
Stars: Katharine Hepburn, Ralph Richardson, Jason Robards
Description: At the end of a long and hot summer day, members of one family gather in a large house. Everyone has something painful and offensive to say, and their silence is even worse.

Title: Dom
Stars: Sergey Garmash, Bogdan Stupka, Yekaterina Rednikova
Description: Compromising family secrets arise when a whole Russian family have their holidays interrupted.

Title: Sang Woo y su abuela
Stars: Eul-boon Kim, Yoo Seung-ho, Dong Hyo-hee
Description: This is the story of a 7-year-old boy, Sang-woo, born and raised in the big city, and his mute grandmother, who has spent her whole life in a small rural village.

Title: La ducha
Stars: Jiayi Du, Zheng Fang, Bing He
Description: A young wealthy businessman's icy attitude toward his working-class background is about to thaw as he is forced to reconnect with his elderly father and mentally challenged younger brother, who together run a public bathhouse.

Title: Respiro
Stars: Valeria Golino, Vincenzo Amato, Francesco Casisa
Description: En una isla italiana empobrecida, una mujer de espíritu libre es acusada de locura por la gente del pueblo harta de sus payasadas.

Title: Evdokiya
Stars: Lyudmila Khityaeva, Nikolay Lebedev, Lyuba Basova
Description: Evdokim, un obrero, y su esposa, Evdokia, viven en un pequeño pueblo suburbano. No tienen hijos, pero crían a sus hijastros a los cuales ven crecer y tomar sus propias vidas.

Title: Tres mujeres
Stars: Anita Björk, Eva Dahlbeck, Maj-Britt Nilsson
Description: The four wives of four brothers share stories of their marriages as they each wait for their husbands in a small, secluded cottage.

Title: Romulus, mi padre
Stars: Eric Bana, Franka Potente, Marton Csokas
Description: It tells the story of Romulus, his beautiful wife, Christina, and their struggle in the face of great adversity to bring up their son, Raimond. It is a story of impossible love that ultimately celebrates the unbreakable bond between father and son.

Title: El castillo de la pureza
Stars: Claudio Brook, Rita Macedo, Arturo Beristáin
Description: La historia de un hombre disciplinado y sexualmente impulsivo que mantiene a su familia aislada en su casa durante años para protegerlos de la "naturaleza malvada" de los seres humanos.

Title: Un lunar en el sol
Stars: Sidney Poitier, Claudia McNeil, Ruby Dee
Description: Un pago de seguro sustancial podría significar la salvación financiera o la ruina personal para una familia afrodescendiente de escasos recursos económicos.

Title: El sueño de Gabrielle
Stars: Marion Cotillard, Louis Garrel, Alex Brendemühl
Description: Gabrielle es una mujer apasionada y abierta que vive en un matrimonio sin amor en la Francia de los 50. Cuando va a los Alpes a tratar sus piedras en el riñón, se enamora de otro hombre. Gabrielle anhela liberarse y escapar con André.

Title: Kunsten at græde i kor
Stars: Jannik Lorenzen, Jesper Asholt, Julie Kolbeck
Description: Southern Jutland, DK, early 1970s: A dysfunctional family is burdened by an evil, self-righteous father, who manipulates his 11 y.o. son and 14 y.o. daughter with his repeated suicide threats.

Title: Cosas que importan
Stars: Meryl Streep, Renée Zellweger, William Hurt
Description: Una mujer de carrera se replantea la vida de sus padres después de verse obligada a cuidar de su madre enferma de cáncer.

Title: El sabor del sake
Stars: Chishû Ryû, Shima Iwashita, Keiji Sada
Description: Un viudo entrado en años acuerda el matrimonio de su única hija.

Title: El país del agua
Stars: Jeremy Irons, Sinéad Cusack, Grant Warnock
Description: En 1974, en Pittsburgh, un profesor de historia de secundaria le cuenta a su clase sobre sus experiencias como adolescente en Inglaterra durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

Title: Regreso a casa - Coming Home
Stars: Gong Li, Daoming Chen, Huiwen Zhang
Description: Lu y Feng forman una pareja devota, forzada a la separación cuando Lu es detenido y llevado a un campo de trabajo para prisioneros políticos durante la Revolución Cultural. Cuando regresa a casa, su amada no le reconoce.

Title: Vidas distantes
Stars: Jill Clayburgh, Barbara Hershey, Martha Plimpton
Description: New York journalist visits her distant cousin for the first time to write an article about her hard life in the bayous of Louisiana. Journalist's wild drug addicted daughter just adds to tensions between two families' cultures.

Title: En el estanque dorado
Stars: Katharine Hepburn, Henry Fonda, Jane Fonda
Description: Norman es un cascarrabias con una relación distanciada con su hija Chelsea. Sin embargo, en el Estanque Dorado, él y su esposa aceptan cuidar de Billy, el hijo del nuevo novio de Chelsea, y florece una relación de lo más inesperada.

Title: Mi familia y otros animales
Stars: Eugene Simon, Imelda Staunton, Chris Langham
Description: An English family relocates to sunny Greece four years before WWII.

Title: La fille du puisatier
Stars: Daniel Auteuil, Astrid Bergès-Frisbey, Nicolas Duvauchelle
Description: En el sur de Francia, en la década de 1930, un padre se debate entre su sentido del honor y el profundo amor que siente por su hija cuando ella se mete en problemas con el hijo rico de un comerciante.

Title: Another year
Stars: Jim Broadbent, Ruth Sheen, Lesley Manville
Description: Primavera, verano, otoño, invierno. Familia y amigos. Amor y calidez. Alegria y tristeza. Esperanza y frustración. Compañía. Soledad. Un nacimiento. Una muerte. El tiempo pasa.

Title: Las horas del verano
Stars: Juliette Binoche, Charles Berling, Jérémie Renier
Description: Dos hermanos y una hermana presencian la desaparición de sus recuerdos de infancia cuando deben ceder los bienes familiares para asegurar la sucesión de su madre fallecida.

Title: Un optimista de vacaciones
Stars: James Stewart, Maureen O'Hara, Fabian
Description: El Sr. Hobbs quiere pasar unas vacaciones tranquilas en la playa, pero su mujer ha invitado a toda su familia a quedarse con ellos.

Title: Raquel, Raquel
Stars: Joanne Woodward, James Olson, Kate Harrington
Description: Rachel es una maestra de escuela solitaria que vive con su madre. Cuando un hombre de la gran ciudad la invita a salir, empieza a pensar en hacia dónde quiere que vaya su vida.

Title: La mujer de Gilles
Stars: Emmanuelle Devos, Clovis Cornillac, Laura Smet
Description: Gilles' wife, Elise, who smiles when she thinks of him, cooks and scrubs and cheerfully makes love to him, suspects during her third pregnancy that he is having an affair with her coquettish younger sister, Victorine. Elise suffers, usually in silence. She listens to her husband rave; she asks her priest; she breaks picture frames; she weeps. She decides on a strategy to keep him. Will she succeed?

Title: Al este del edén
Stars: Julie Harris, James Dean, Raymond Massey
Description: Un joven compite con su hermano por la atención de su religioso padre, mientras reconecta con su ausente madre, y se enamora de la chica equivocada.

Title: Como agua para chocolate
Stars: Marco Leonardi, Lumi Cavazos, Regina Torné
Description: Una joven no puede casarse con el hombre que ama, pero descubre que tiene una talento único para la cocina.

Title: Captain Fantastic
Stars: Viggo Mortensen, George MacKay, Samantha Isler
Description: En los bosques del noroeste del Pacífico, un padre dedicado a cuidar a sus seis hijos con una educación física e intelectual rigurosa debe dejar su paraíso para entrar en un mundo que pone en tela de juicio la idea de lo que significa ser un padre.

Title: Kompani Orheim
Stars: Vebjørn Enger, Kristoffer Joner, Cecilie A. Mosli
Description: Jarle Klepp gets a message that forces his mind back to something he'd rather forgotten - his childhood with his father in Stavanger. When "Orheim" was his surname.

Title: El largo día acaba
Stars: Marjorie Yates, Leigh McCormack, Anthony Watson
Description: Un joven de Liverpool alcanza la mayoría de edad en la década de 1950 entre su amada familia y la austera Iglesia católica. Cuando entra en los rigores de la escuela, alimenta un deslumbrante amor por el cine y anhela compañía.

Title: Las manos en los bolsillos
Stars: Lou Castel, Paola Pitagora, Marino Masé
Description: Un joven toma medidas drásticas para librar a su familia disfuncional de distintos problemas.

Title: La tormenta de hielo
Stars: Kevin Kline, Joan Allen, William Cain
Description: De pronto cae una tormenta de hielo. No pueden salir de la casa. En su interior la familia comienza a hacer frente a todas sus contradicciones y problemas. Son los problemas de una familia burguesa en la década de los setenta.

Title: Sólo ellos
Stars: Clive Owen, Emma Booth, Laura Fraser
Description: Un escritor deportivo se convierte en padre soltero en circunstancias trágicas.

Title: Mama
Stars: Nonna Mordyukova, Vladimir Mashkov, Oleg Menshikov
Description: A chronicle of a Soviet family folk-band founded by a mother of six.

Title: Mama vyshla zamuzh
Stars: Lyusena Ovchinnikova, Nikolay Burlyaev, Oleg Efremov
Description: Zina raised her son Borka alone, and now that her son is almost an adult, Victor has appeared in her life.

Title: Quédate a mi lado
Stars: Julia Roberts, Susan Sarandon, Ed Harris
Description: Una mujer enferma terminal debe lidiar con la nueva amante de su exmarido, que será la madrastra de sus hijos.

Title: Esperando a Mr. Bridge
Stars: Paul Newman, Saundra McClain, Joanne Woodward
Description: Ambientada durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial, una familia de clase alta comienza a desmoronarse debido a la naturaleza conservadora del patriarca y los valores progresistas de sus hijos.

Title: Más vale sola que mal acompañada
Stars: Renée Zellweger, Logan Lerman, Kevin Bacon
Description: Tras abandonar a su marido, una mujer recorre los Estados Unidos con sus dos hijos buscando desesperadamente un hombre capaz de mantenerlos económicamente. Basada en las memorias del actor George Hamilton.

Title: El rey de California
Stars: Michael Douglas, Evan Rachel Wood, Willis Burks II
Description: Un padre inestable que tras salir de una institución psiquiátrica intenta convencer a su hija de que hay oro español enterrado en algún lugar bajo los suburbios.

Title: Molodaya zhena
Stars: Anna Kamenkova, Vladlen Biryukov, Galina Makarova
Description: To spite the deceiver-groom, young Manya marries a widower with a child. Difficult love in the Soviet countryside.

Title: Un lugar para soñar
Stars: Matt Damon, Scarlett Johansson, Thomas Haden Church
Description: En el sur de California, una familia se muda a una zona rural para renovar y reabrir un zoo destartalado.

Title: Nebo nashego detstva
Stars: Nasreddin Dubashev, Sovetbek Dzhumadylov, Muratbek Ryskulov
Description: In the name of progress, the old folk traditions and ethnic rituals of the mountainous Kirghiz country are ruthlessly suppressed.

Title: Sin amor
Stars: Maryana Spivak, Aleksey Rozin, Matvey Novikov
Description: Una pareja que se está divorciando debe unirse para encontrar a su hijo, que ha desaparecido durante una de sus amargas discusiones.

Title: Promesa al amanecer
Stars: Pierre Niney, Charlotte Gainsbourg, Didier Bourdon
Description: A man recounts his life, from his childhood through his experiences in World War II, and the story of his self-sacrificing mother, who raised him alone.

Title: Olivier, Olivier
Stars: Frédéric Quiring, Faye Gatteau, Emmanuel Morozof
Description: Olivier, un niño de nueve años, desaparece una tarde camino a casa de su abuela. Las consecuencias emocionales de su desaparición obligan a su padre a irse de Francia a África y casi destrozan a su madre, quien se aferra a su hija restante

Title: Mr & Mme Adelman
Stars: Doria Tillier, Nicolas Bedos, Denis Podalydès
Description: Sarah y Victor llevan juntos más de 45 años. ¿Cómo lo han conseguido? ¿Quién es realmente Sarah, esta enigmática mujer que siempre ha estado a la sombra de su marido? Amor, ambición y secretos alimentan la odisea de esta insólita pareja.

Title: Corazones enfrentados
Stars: Laura Fraser, Adam Monty, Isabella Rossellini
Description: Against a background of holocaust memories, a liberal Jewish girl becomes a nanny to a young Jewish boy with a disability and grows fond of him.

Title: Brutos, feos y malos
Stars: Francesco Anniballi, Maria Bosco, Giselda Castrini
Description: Giacinto Mazzatella y su familia participan en robos, prostitución y otras actividades. El gobierno le otorga a Giacinto un millón por la pérdida de su ojo. Ahora su familia lo matará por el dinero.

Title: Otets
Stars: Polina Kutepova, Svetlana Ivanova, Vasiliy Prokopev
Description: The war is over, but instead of happiness and joy, Alexey Ivanov experiences bitterness and fear. It is necessary to return home, but do his children remember whom he left as toddlers? Does Lyuba's wife remember? The girl Masha, who is returning to her hometown, where she has no one left except distant relatives, is equally anxious at heart. Fate brings Masha and Alexey together on a train that takes them to their native lands. When he stops at the train station, Alexey goes out with the girl and stays with her for a couple of days... And then, promising Masha to "remember her bright image," he goes to his own. At home, everything seems to be in order: the wife and children are alive and well... Alexey can't get used to peaceful life again. In the war, where every day could be the last, everything was clear, but here... It is necessary to try to understand the wife and children with their past and new concerns. And Alexey learns to live anew - to forgive and love.

Title: El regreso
Stars: Vladimir Garin, Ivan Dobronravov, Konstantin Lavronenko
Description: En el desierto ruso, dos hermanos enfrentan una variedad de emociones nuevas y conflictivas cuando su padre, un hombre al que conocen solo a través de una sola fotografía, resurge.

Title: Parásitos
Stars: Song Kang-ho, Lee Sun-kyun, Cho Yeo-jeong
Description: La familia Ki-taek, todos desempleados, se ve envuelta en un incidente con la rica y glamurosa familia Parks.

Title: La prima cosa bella
Stars: Valerio Mastandrea, Micaela Ramazzotti, Stefania Sandrelli
Description: Un profesor de literatura en Milán sobrevive a los recuerdos de una infancia de novela y a la belleza embarazosa de una madre vital y extrovertida; todo empezó en 1971 cuando su madre fue coronada como la mamá más bella del verano.

Title: Siempre estoy sola
Stars: Anne Bancroft, Peter Finch, James Mason
Description: Jo y su tercer marido, Jake, viven con seis de sus hijos, pero el matrimonio se ve afectado por numerosos factores. Su doctor cree que Jo usa la natalidad como fin para el sexo. Los problemas de Jo la dejan en un delicado estado mental.

Title: El prado
Stars: Richard Harris, Sean Bean, Frances Tomelty
Description: Cuando el terreno que ha pertenecido a la familia McCabe durante generaciones sale a subasta, el patriarca de los McCabe no se detendrá ante nada para evitar que un rico estadounidense lo compre.

Title: De laatste dagen van Emma Blank
Stars: Marlies Heuer, Gene Bervoets, Annet Malherbe
Description: A woman living in a large country home drives her servants to mutiny with her outrageous demands as she waits for death to come for her.

Title: Warum läuft Herr R. Amok
Stars: Michael Fengler, Lilith Ungerer, Kurt Raab, Amadeus Fengler
Description: With slicked-down hair and three-piece suits, dependable Herr Raab is a technical draftsman. He gets along with his colleagues although his boss wants him to go beyond technical cleanliness to problem solving. He's a dutiful husband; his wife's a social climber and pushes him to seek a promotion, but they also share sweet moments. He's a caring father, helping his son with homework. His parents visit; his mother criticizes his wife. Old School friends drop by, as do neighbors. Some comment on Raab's wife's expensive tastes. His promotion may be a long shot, especially after he gives a dull and tipsy toast at an office dinner. But why would Herr Raab run amok?

Title: Las cenizas de Ángela
Stars: Emily Watson, Robert Carlyle, Joe Breen
Description: Sigue las experiencias del joven Frankie y su familia mientras intentan contra viento y marea escapar de la pobreza endémica en los barrios marginales de Limerick antes de la guerra.

Title: The Act
Stars: Michelle Dean, Patricia Arquette, Joey King, AnnaSophia Robb
Description: Serie antológica que cuenta las historias de crímenes verídicos.

Title: A contracorriente
Stars: Geoffrey Rush, Judy Davis, Jesse Spencer
Description: The inspirational life story of Australian swimmer Tony Fingleton.

Title: Nader y Simin, una separación
Stars: Payman Maadi, Leila Hatami, Sareh Bayat
Description: Una pareja casada se enfrenta a una decisión difícil: mejorar la vida de su hijo mudándose a otro país o quedándose en Irán y cuidando a un padre demente que padece de Alzheimer.

Title: La bûche (Cena de Navidad)
Stars: Sabine Azéma, Emmanuelle Béart, Charlotte Gainsbourg
Description: Christmas, family, and infidelity. Yvette's husband has died, and her grown daughters join her at the grave: Sonia, wealthy, bourgeois, and generous; Louba, living with their dad Stanislas, singing at a Russian restaurant, penniless, the mistress for the past 12 years of a man who will never leave his wife; Milla, the youngest, acerbic, lonesome. Christmas was when they learned their parents were divorcing 25 years ago. Over the next few days, yuletide depression, Louba's pregnancy, Sonia's crumbling marriage, Stanislas's overtures to Yvette, and Milla's attraction to the man who's her father's rent-free lodger lead each one to re-examine self, family, and hopes. Is renewal possible?

Title: Los Tenenbaums. Una familia de genios
Stars: Gene Hackman, Anjelica Huston, Ben Stiller
Description: Los excéntricos miembros de una familia disfuncional se encuentran bajo el mismo techo.

Title: Family Life
Stars: Sandy Ratcliff, Bill Dean, Grace Cave
Description: A family is shattered over the daughter's forced abortion. As she rebels against her family and their traditional, authoritarian, typical-of-the-time norms, she is hospitalized and otherwise mistreated.

Title: El zoo de cristal
Stars: Katharine Hepburn, Sam Waterston, Joanna Miles
Description: Amanda Wingfield dominates her children with her faded gentility and exaggerated tales of her Southern belle past. Her son plans escape; her daughter withdraws into a dream world. When a "gentleman caller" appears, things move to crisis point.

Title: Happiness
Stars: Jane Adams, Jon Lovitz, Philip Seymour Hoffman
Description: Las vidas de varios individuos se entrelazan mientras cada uno vive a su propia manera su desesperada búsqueda de conexiones humanas.

Title: Los padres terribles
Stars: Jean Marais, Josette Day, Yvonne de Bray
Description: Michel is in love with Madeleine, so he decides to tell his parents of his intention to marry her. He thinks his announcement is innocent enough; his engagement, however, threatens to reveal dark secrets lurking within his family's home.

Title: Hannah y sus hermanas
Stars: Barbara Hershey, Carrie Fisher, Michael Caine
Description: En el año que transcurre entre dos días de Acción de Gracias, el marido de Hanna se enamora de su hermana Lee, y su hipocondríaco exmarido empieza a salir con su hermana Holly.

Title: Un hombre que grita
Stars: Youssouf Djaoro, Diouc Koma, Emile Abossolo M'bo
Description: Present-day Chad. Adam, fifty-five, a former swimming champion, is pool attendant at a smart N'Djamena hotel. When the hotel gets taken over by new Chinese owners, he is forced to give up his job to his son Abdel. Terribly resentful, he feels socially humiliated. The country is in the throes of a civil war. Rebel forces are attacking the government. The authorities demand that the population contribute to the "war effort", giving money or volunteers old enough to fight off the assailants. The District Chief constantly harasses Adam for his contribution. But Adam is penniless; he only has his son....

Title: Chelovek, kotorogo ya lyublyu
Stars: Georgi Zhzhyonov, Evgeniy Gerasimov, Nikolay Merzlikin

Title: Dos mujeres
Stars: Sophia Loren, Jean-Paul Belmondo, Eleonora Brown
Description: En la Italia de la Segunda Guerra Mundial, una viuda y su solitaria hija tratan de poner distancia entre ellas y los horrores de la guerra.

Title: Olive Kitteridge
Stars: Richard Jenkins, Ann Dowd
Description: Relata la vida de Olive, una profesora de matemáticas, y su matrimonio de más de 25 años con Henry.

Title: ¿Qué fue de Baby Jane?
Stars: Bette Davis, Joan Crawford, Victor Buono
Description: Una antigua estrella infantil de cine atormenta a su hermana parapléjica en la deteriorada mansión en la que viven en Hollywood.

Title: La extraña
Stars: Sibel Kekilli, Nizam Schiller, Derya Alabora
Description: Umay is a young woman of Turkish descent, fighting for an independent and self-determined life in Germany against her family's resistance. Her struggle initiates a dynamic that results in a life-threatening situation.

Title: El Bola
Stars: Juan José Ballesta, Pablo Galán, Alberto Jiménez
Description: Un pequeño de 12 años sufre maltrato físico en casa de manos de su padre alcohólico.

Title: Gritos y susurros
Stars: Harriet Andersson, Kari Sylwan, Ingrid Thulin
Description: Cuando una mujer muriéndose de cáncer a principios del siglo XX en Suecia es visitada por sus dos hermanas, los sentimientos reprimidos entre las hermanas salen a la superficie.

Title: El soplo en el corazón
Stars: Lea Massari, Benoît Ferreux, Daniel Gélin
Description: A medida que se aproxima el fin de la primera guerra de Indochina, un adolescente se siente dividido entre el amor maternal y el amor rebelde que quisiera descubrir.

Title: Ich will doch nur, daß ihr mich liebt
Stars: Vitus Zeplichal, Elke Aberle, Alexander Allerson
Description: A man is interviewed by a sympathetic woman. His tale unfolds, of hard work that never pleases his parents, of a father who denigrates his efforts, of an indifferent mother. He builds them a house. Instead of offering their flat to him and his bride, they give the flat up, so he goes to Munich to work in construction, bringing his wife who is soon pregnant. They buy things on credit; he works overtime. He shows up with flowers and expensive gifts. When construction slows and he works less overtime, he cannot adjust his spending habits: he needs to be loved. Pressures mount. When he snaps, and violence ensues, who will be his victim?

Title: Yazichniki
Stars: Elena Nesterova, Valentin Samokhin, Vitaliya Enshina

Title: Kes
Stars: David Bradley, Freddie Fletcher, Lynne Perrie
Description: Un joven inglés de clase obrera pasa su tiempo libre cuidando y entrenando a un halcón.

Title: Svet v okne
Stars: Yuriy Solomin, Tamara Degtyaryova, Margarita Sergeyecheva
Description: After the death of her mother, the girl remains with her newborn sister and her father, who has a new woman.

Title: Génova
Stars: Colin Firth, Perla Haney-Jardine, Willa Holland
Description: Tras la muerte de su esposa, un padre lleva a sus hijas a Italia, donde la menor ve el fantasma de su madre y la mayor explora su sexualidad.

Title: Las mejores intenciones
Stars: Samuel Fröler, Pernilla August, Max von Sydow
Description: En 1909, el pobre estudiante de teología Henrik se enamora de Anna, la hija de una familia rica en Uppsala. Después de casarse, Henrik se convierte en sacerdote en el norte de Suecia. La citadina Anna odia vivir lejos de la zona urbana.

Title: C.R.A.Z.Y.
Stars: Michel Côté, Marc-André Grondin, Danielle Proulx
Description: Un joven francocanadiense, que creció en las décadas de 1960 y 1970, lucha por reconciliar su homosexualidad emergente con los valores conservadores de su padre y sus propias creencias católicas.

Title: El gruñón
Stars: Antti Litja, Petra Frey, Mari Perankoski
Description: A grumpy old man who hates post-1953 changes falls and must spend a weekend in Helsinki. His injury forces family time and involvement in his daughter-in-law's business deal, while confronting his own failings as a father.

Title: Voskresnyy papa
Stars: Dmitriy Grankin, Yuriy Duvanov, Tamara Akulova

Title: Con él llegó el escándalo
Stars: Robert Mitchum, Eleanor Parker, George Peppard
Description: La dramática historia de la influyente familia Hunnicutt, ambientada en Texas a finales de la década de 1950.

Title: Eshche odin god
Stars: Nadya Lumpova, Aleksey Filimonov, Natalya Tereshkova
Description: Young married couple in today's Moscow: He's an unemployed guy who gets some money by giving rides to strangers at nights. She's a young graphic designer who just got her first job. The film tracks their unstable relationship throughout a year.

Title: La buena esposa
Stars: Glenn Close, Jonathan Pryce, Max Irons
Description: Una esposa cuestiona sus elecciones vitales mientras viaja a Estocolmo con su esposo, donde este recibirá el Premio Nobel de Literatura.

Title: La mujer del año
Stars: Spencer Tracy, Katharine Hepburn, Fay Bainter
Description: Los periodistas rivales Sam y Tess se enamoran y se casan, pero su relación se resiente cuando a Sam le molesta el agitado estilo de vida de Tess.

Title: Ve'Lakhta Lehe Isha
Stars: Shlomi Elkabetz, Ronit Elkabetz, Simon Abkarian, Gilbert Melki
Description: La historia tiene lugar en Haifa, Israel, en 1979, durante tres días antes del Shabat. Una joven esponsa intenta criar a tres hijos, trabajar desde casa y observar las estrictas normas marroquíes.

Title: Kâbê
Stars: Sayuri Yoshinaga, Tadanobu Asano, Rei Dan
Description: In 1930s Japan, a mother endures hardship to raise her children when her academic husband is marked as an enemy of the state and imprisoned.

Title: El incomprendido
Stars: Anthony Quayle, Stefano Colagrande, Simone Giannozzi
Description: A study of bitter relationships between a widower and his two sons.

Title: Baaria
Stars: Francesco Scianna, Margareth Madè, Lina Sastri
Description: Baaria is Sicilian slang for Bagheria where Tornatore was born and this is an autobiographic epic of three generations in the Sicilian village where he was born.

Title: Funuke domo, kanashimi no ai wo misero
Stars: Eriko Satô, Aimi Satsukawa, Hiromi Nagasaku
Description: Traumatic incidents, conflicts, and bloody quarrels awaits the Wago family members who return home to bury their parents.

Title: Carácter
Stars: Jan Decleir, Fedja van Huêt, Betty Schuurman
Description: Un joven lucha en la dura Holanda de principios del siglo XX por llegar a ser abogado. Ademas debe lidiar con la difícil relación que mantiene con sus padres y con las mujeres.

Title: Pokhoronite menya za plintusom
Stars: Svetlana Kryuchkova, Aleksey Petrenko, Mariya Shukshina
Description: A small child is trapped in a tug-of-war battle between his frivolous, but loving mother and an emotionally abusive neurotic grandmother, who wants to "shelter" her beloved grandson at all cost.

Title: Big Little Lies
Stars: Reese Witherspoon, Nicole Kidman, Shailene Woodley
Description: Las vidas aparentemente perfectas de tres madres de alumnos de primaria se ven envueltas en un asesinato.

Title: El árbol de la vida
Stars: Brad Pitt, Sean Penn, Jessica Chastain
Description: La historia de una familia en Waco, Texas en 1956. El hijo mayor es testigo de la pérdida de la inocencia y lucha con las enseñanzas contrapuestas de sus padres.

Title: Papá está en viaje de negocios
Stars: Moreno De Bartoli, Predrag 'Miki' Manojlovic, Mirjana Karanovic
Description: Una familia se ve profundamente afectada por las aventuras extramaritales de su padre y las turbulentas consecuencias de la separación de Tito-Stalin.

Title: El viaje de Nisha
Stars: Maria Mozhdah, Adil Hussain, Ekavali Khanna
Description: Nisha lleva una doble vida como perfecta hija pakistaní en casa y como adolescente noruega ordinaria con sus amigos, hasta que estas dos realidades colisionan.

Title: We the Animals
Stars: Evan Rosado, Raúl Castillo, Sheila Vand
Description: Manny, Joel, and Jonah tear their way through childhood and push against the volatile love of their parents. As Manny and Joel grow into versions of their father and Ma dreams of escape, Jonah embraces an imagined world all on his own.

Title: This Is Us
Stars: Milo Ventimiglia, Mandy Moore, Sterling K. Brown
Description: La conmovedora y emotiva historia de unos trillizos singulares, sus dificultades y sus maravillosos padres.

Title: De tal padre, tal hijo
Stars: Masaharu Fukuyama, Machiko Ono, Yôko Maki
Description: Ryota es un exitoso hombre de negocios adicto al trabajo. Cuando se entera de que su hijo biológico fue cambiado por otro después de nacer, se enfrenta a la decisión de elegir a su verdadero hijo o al que ha criado como propio.

Title: Nadie sabe
Stars: Yûya Yagira, Ayu Kitaura, Hiei Kimura
Description: En un pequeño apartamento de Tokio, Akira, de doce años, debe cuidar de sus hermanos menores después de que su madre los deja y no da señales de regresar.

Title: La traversée de l'Atlantique à la rame
Stars: Charlotte Maury-Sentier, Jean-Pierre Sentier
Description: A short film about a couple who leave their home in New York City and spend the rest of their lives in a boat in the Atlantic Ocean.

Title: El regreso de Ben
Stars: Julia Roberts, Lucas Hedges, Courtney B. Vance
Description: Un adolescente drogadicto se presenta inesperadamente en casa de su familia en Nochebuena.

Title: Oriente es oriente
Stars: Om Puri, Linda Bassett, Jordan Routledge
Description: A principios de la década de 1970 en Inglaterra, un padre paquistaní encuentra la autoridad que había mantenido anteriormente desafiada por sus hijos cada vez más anglicizados.

Title: Un lugar en ninguna parte
Stars: Christine Lahti, River Phoenix, Judd Hirsch
Description: El hijo mayor de una familia fugitiva cumple la mayoría de edad y decide vivir su propia vida.

Title: El sur
Stars: Omero Antonutti, Sonsoles Aranguren, Icíar Bollaín
Description: Una mujer reflexiona sobre su relación con su padre durante su infancia, intentando comprender la profundidad de su desesperación y la verdad tras sus mitos.

Title: Un asunto de familia
Stars: Lily Franky, Sakura Andô, Kirin Kiki
Description: Una familia japonesa con ingresos insuficientes depende del robo para llegar a fin de mes.

Title: Fences
Stars: Denzel Washington, Viola Davis, Stephen McKinley Henderson
Description: Un padre afro-americano de clase obrera cría una familia en los 50, al tiempo que intenta aceptar los acontecimientos de su vida.

Title: Ottsy i dedy
Stars: Anatoliy Papanov, Valentin Smirnitskiy, Aleksey Yasulovich
Description: Lukovs family lived peacefully until their grandpa Aleksey started to prove that he is not old.

Title: El perro mongol
Stars: Batchuluun Urjindorj, Buyandulam Daramdadi, Nansal Batchuluun
Description: The little Nansal finds a baby dog in the Mongolian veld, who becomes her best friend against all rejections of her parents.

Title: La ganadora
Stars: Julianne Moore, Woody Harrelson, Laura Dern
Description: In 1950s Ohio, a mother of 10 enters jingle contests to support her family, while her alcoholic husband struggles with a dead-end job. She faces poverty and abuse, but remains optimistic as she tries to keep her large family together.

Title: Madre e hijo
Stars: Luminita Gheorghiu, Bogdan Dumitrache, Natasa Raab
Description: After the terrible news of a fatal car accident involving her son, a desperate mother will do anything in her power to set her child free.

Title: Principios de verano
Stars: Setsuko Hara, Chishû Ryû, Chikage Awashima
Description: A family chooses a match for their daughter Noriko, but she, surprisingly, has her own plans.

Title: Después de la tormenta
Stars: Hiroshi Abe, Yôko Maki, Satomi Kobayashi
Description: Tras la muerte de su padre, un detective privado trata de conseguir dinero para pagar la manutención de su hijo y recuperar la relación con él y con su exesposa.

Title: Angustia de un querer
Stars: Catherine Deneuve, Marcello Mastroianni, Serge Marquand
Description: Catherine and Marcello are secluded in their house, living under the candlelight. Unable to accept the injustice behind the loss of their nine-month-old baby, they face a slow but definite self-destruction.

Title: Días de radio
Stars: Mike Starr, Paul Herman, Don Pardo
Description: Una mirada nostálgica a la edad de oro de la radio que se centra en una familia normal y los diversos artistas del medio.

Title: El castillo de cristal
Stars: Brie Larson, Woody Harrelson, Naomi Watts
Description: Una joven crece en una familia disfuncional de nómadas inconformistas, con una madre que es una artista excéntrica y un padre alcohólico que intenta despertar la imaginación de los niños con la esperanza de distraerlos de su pobreza.

Title: La habitación
Stars: Brie Larson, Jacob Tremblay, Sean Bridgers
Description: Un niño es mantenido cautivo en una habitación con su madre desde su nacimiento, por lo que nunca ha conocido el mundo exterior.

Title: Together (Juntos)
Stars: Yun Tang, Peiqi Liu, Hong Chen
Description: A violin prodigy and his father travel to Beijing, where the father seeks the means to his son's success while the son struggles to accept the path laid before him.

Title: Diez horas al paraíso
Stars: Kim Kold, Elsebeth Steentoft, Lamaiporn Sangmanee Hougaard
Description: Dennis, a painfully shy 38-year-old bodybuilder who lives with his mother, sets off to Thailand in search of love.

Title: Una mujer bajo la influencia
Stars: Peter Falk, Gena Rowlands, Fred Draper
Description: Mabel, mujer y madre, es querida por su esposo Nick, a pesar del reto que su enfermedad mental impone.

Title: Sin testigos
Stars: Irina Kupchenko, Mikhail Ulyanov, Eduard Artemyev
Description: Without Witness is an unflinchingly intimate and wickedly plotted two-actor tour de force pitting a divorced couple against each other and themselves.

Title: Elegía de Naniwa
Stars: Isuzu Yamada, Yôko Umemura, Chiyoko Ôkura
Description: A young woman becomes a mistress of her boss in order to support her family.

Title: Secret Sunshine
Stars: Jeon Do-yeon, Song Kang-ho, Lee Dong-yong
Description: Una mujer se traslada al pueblo donde nació su difunto marido. Mientras intenta integrarse, otro trágico acontecimiento trastoca su vida.

Title: Oda a mi padre
Stars: Hwang Jung-min, Yunjin Kim, Oh Dal-su
Description: Amid the time of Korean War, a young boy's vow to take care of his family marked the beginning of a lifelong promise spanning 60 years.

Title: Los momentos eternos de Maria Larssons
Stars: Maria Heiskanen, Mikael Persbrandt, Jesper Christensen
Description: In a time of social change and unrest, war and poverty, a young working class woman, Maria, wins a camera in a lottery. The decision to keep it alters her whole life.

Title: Davay razvedyomsya!
Stars: Anna Mikhalkova, Olga Albanova, Vitali Daushev
Description: Masha, a gynaecology doctor, is so absorbed by her work that she doesn't immediately come to notice that her husband is about to leave her. Her life is shattered: Masha is overloaded at work, and her kids are demanding constant attention. Used to winning, Masha isn't ready to hand over her beloved husband to a young and stunning-looking fitness trainer. Masha won't stop at anything to get him back, including turning to supernatural forces. But her new life opens up new opportunities, so is this old barely flickering flame really worth reigniting?

Title: Dvoe
Stars: Anton Momot, Tatyana Polosina, Andrei Shchepochkin
Description: Having despaired to restore her health by traditional medicine, Nadia persuades her husband Andrei to hike to a radon lake in the hope of a cure. Andrei agrees. On the journey, away from Nadia's harsh father, he plans to tell her that he wants to le for a divorce. But nature interferes with their plans.

Title: Kak Vitka Chesnok vyoz Lyokhu Shtyrya v dom invalidov
Stars: Evgeniy Tkachuk, Aleksey Serebryakov, Andrey Smirnov
Description: Hoping to claim his newly-vacated apartment, a young man travels across Russia with his aging gangster father to admit him into a nursing home.

Title: Brak
Stars: Irina Muravyova, Garri Bardin, Gennadiy Khazanov
Description: A story of acquaintance, love, marriage and family life, told with the help of two ropes.

Title: Rodnya
Stars: Nonna Mordyukova, Svetlana Kryuchkova, Yuriy Bogatyryov
Description: A woman from the countryside comes to the city to visit her only daughter and granddaughter. She is hopelessly lost in this world she does not understand.

Title: Tretya meshchanskaya
Stars: Vladimir Fogel, Nikolay Batalov, Lyudmila Semyonova
Description: A married couple have a small apartment in Moscow. When an old friend of the husband's arrives in the city, he is unable to find lodgings. Kolia, the husband, invites his friend to move in with them.

Title: Povorot
Stars: Oleg Yankovskiy, Irina Kupchenko, Anatoliy Solonitsyn
Description: Returning to Moscow from their honeymoon, a young couple strike and kill an elderly pedestrian. The husband must stand trial, but is it fair, he thinks. She was old and negligent and poor. Why should his life be ruined?

Title: Chaharshanbe-soori
Stars: Hediyeh Tehrani, Taraneh Alidoosti, Hamid Farrokhnezhad
Description: On the last Wednesday before the spring solstice ushers in the Persian New Year, people set off fireworks following an ancient Zoroastrian tradition. Rouhi, spending her first day at a new job, finds herself in the midst of a different kind of fireworks -- a domestic dispute between her new boss and his wife.

Title: Él
Stars: Arturo de Córdova, Delia Garcés, Aurora Walker
Description: El exterior suave de un marido se deshace después de su matrimonio, y desata su temperamento paranoico y volátil en su esposa, que se intensifica a rabietas más peligrosas e impredecibles.

Title: La ruleta china
Stars: Anna Karina, Margit Carstensen, Brigitte Mira
Description: Both parents of a young teen who walks with crutches secretly meet their lovers, who both surprise each other at the family's country home. The daughter arrives and initiates a guessing game of "Chinese roulette."

Title: El mercader de las cuatro estaciones
Stars: Hans Hirschmüller, Irm Hermann, Hanna Schygulla
Description: Hans Epp, un hombre con tendencias autodestructivas, busca significado a la vida vendiendo fruta sin conseguirlo, y su desafección se convierte en desesperación.

Title: Tully
Stars: Charlize Theron, Mackenzie Davis, Ron Livingston
Description: Una madre de tres niños contrata a una niñera nocturna para que la ayude con su recién nacido.

Title: Aritmiya
Stars: Aleksandr Yatsenko, Irina Gorbacheva, Nikolay Shrayber
Description: Un paramédico dedicado a sus pacientes lucha por hacer tiempo para su esposa, quien comienza a creer que sus pacientes son más importantes para él.

Title: Te querré siempre
Stars: Ingrid Bergman, George Sanders, Maria Mauban
Description: Una pareja infelizmente casada intenta encontrar dirección y conocimiento durante sus vacaciones en Nápoles.

Title: Father and Daughter
Stars: James Laufer
Description: A father says goodbye to his young daughter. Time passes and the daughter moves through life age by age, but within her there is always a deep longing for her father.

Title: Casta invencible
Stars: Paul Newman, Henry Fonda, Lee Remick
Description: Una familia de madereros de Oregon lucha por mantener vivo el negocio familiar en medio de tiempos cambiantes.

Title: Guerreros de antaño
Stars: Rena Owen, Temuera Morrison, Mamaengaroa Kerr-Bell
Description: Una familia descendiente de guerreros maoríes está atormentada por un padre violento y los problemas sociales de ser tratados como marginados.

Title: Mommy
Stars: Anne Dorval, Suzanne Clément, Antoine Olivier Pilon
Description: Una madre viuda cría sola a su violento hijo y encuentra nueva esperanza cuando su misteriosa vecina se viene a vivir con ellos.

Title: Solo el fin del mundo
Stars: Nathalie Baye, Vincent Cassel, Marion Cotillard
Description: Louis (Gaspard Ulliel), un escritor con una enfermedad terminal, regresa a casa después de una larga ausencia para contar a su familia que se está muriendo.

Title: Saraband
Stars: Liv Ullmann, Erland Josephson, Börje Ahlstedt
Description: Unos treinta años después de divorciarse de Johan, Marianne decide ir a la casa de verano de su exmarido para hacerle una visita. Al llegar, se encuentra en medio de un drama familiar entre el hijo de Johan, de otro matrimonio, y su nieta.

Title: El mundo de Bimala
Stars: Soumitra Chatterjee, Victor Banerjee, Swatilekha Sengupta
Description: Una mujer recuerda su pasado: su marido, que le ofreció contra toda costumbre una educación, y el compañero de universidad de este, lider de una rebelión contra la regla británica.

Title: Charulata. La esposa solitaria
Stars: Soumitra Chatterjee, Madhavi Mukherjee, Shailen Mukherjee
Description: La esposa solitaria del editor de un periódico se enamora de su primo político, que está de visita, y que comparte su pasión por la literatura.

Title: Mahanagar
Stars: Anil Chatterjee, Madhavi Mukherjee, Jaya Bachchan
Description: Life at home changes when a house-wife from a middle-class, conservative family in Calcutta gets a job as a saleswoman.

Title: Van Gogi
Stars: Aleksey Serebryakov, Daniel Olbrychski, Elena Koreneva
Description: Mark Ginzburg es un artista talentoso que está deprimido, tiene 52 años, pero el éxito personal y profesional se le ha escapado de las manos.

Title: Syostry
Stars: Oksana Akinshina, Katya Gorina, Roman Ageev
Description: Two young girls, Sveta and Dina, go on the run to avoid being kidnapped by the former associates of Dina's recently-released gangster father.

Title: Dejad paso al mañana
Stars: Victor Moore, Beulah Bondi, Fay Bainter
Description: Una pareja de ancianos se ve forzada a separarse cuando pierden su casa y ninguno de sus hijos quiere aceptarlos a ambos en sus hogares.

Title: Dalshe: Tishina
Stars: Valeriy Gorbatsevich, Rostislav Plyatt, Faina Ranevskaya, Tatyana Novikova
Description: Soviet television version of the performance of the Mossovet Theatre in 1978. Written by Viña Delmar "Make Way for Tomorrow". For thirteen years, the production was accompanied by continued success.

Title: Tsena
Stars: Mikhail Gluzskiy, Aleksandra Klimova, Leonid Gallis

Title: ¿Quién teme a Virginia Woolf?
Stars: Elizabeth Taylor, Richard Burton, George Segal
Description: Una pareja amargada y envejecida, con la ayuda del alcohol, utiliza a sus jóvenes huéspedes para alimentar la angustia y el dolor emocional hacia el otro en el transcurso de una angustiosa noche.

Title: La noche
Stars: Jeanne Moreau, Marcello Mastroianni, Monica Vitti
Description: Un día en la vida de un matrimonio infiel y el constante deterioro de su relación.

Title: Milou en mayo
Stars: Marcel Bories, Michel Piccoli, Paulette Dubost
Description: Durante los acontecimientos de Mayo del 68 en Francia diferentes formas de ver el mundo enfrentan a los miembros de una familia en su casa de campo.

Title: Eldfjall
Stars: Auður Drauma Bachmann, Þorsteinn Bachmann, Kristín Davíðsdóttir
Description: Hannes is an old man who has grown apart from his children. Recently retired when his wife gets ill he tries to reconcile with them and to atone for his cold demeanor in the past.

Title: Incompresa
Stars: Giulia Salerno, Charlotte Gainsbourg, Gabriel Garko
Description: Rome, 1984, Aria is nine-year-old girl. On the verge of divorce, Aria's infantile and selfish parents are too preoccupied with their careers and extra-marital affairs to properly tend to any of Aria's needs. While her two older sisters are pampered, Aria is treated with cold indifference. Yet she yearns to love and to be loved. At school, Aria excels academically but is considered a misfit by everyone. She is misunderstood. Aria finds comfort in her cat - Dac and in her best friend - Angelica. Thrown out of both parents' homes, abandoned by all, even her best friend, Aria finally reaches the limit of what she can bear. She makes an unexpected decision in her life.

Title: La vida conyugal (Jean-Marc)
Stars: Jacques Charrier, Marie-José Nat, Michel Subor
Description: The story of the couple from the very first meeting to break up told from a view of a man, Jean-Marc. The film shares the same plot with "Françoise ou La vie conjugale", that tells the same story from another perspective.

Title: La vida conyugal (Françoise)
Stars: Marie-José Nat, Jacques Charrier, Michel Subor
Description: The story of the couple from the very first meeting to break up told from a view of a woman, Francoise. The film shares the same plot with "Jean-Marc ou La vie conjugale", that tells the same story from another perspective.

Title: Bomzh (Bez opredelyonnogo mesta zhitelstva)
Stars: Vladimir Steklov, Sergei Kharvat, Tamara Syomina
Description: After living half of his life, the hero remembers that somewhere in a provincial town lives his ex-wife and his grown-up son. He goes to a place where he is neither expected nor remembered.

Title: Kleine Teun
Stars: Alex van Warmerdam, Annet Malherbe, Ariane Schluter
Description: The wife of an illiterate farmer hires a beautiful woman to teach him how to read and write.

Title: Zapomnite menya takoy
Stars: Angelina Stepanova, Oleg Borisov, Iya Savvina
Description: A multigenerational Russian family discusses their lives and crash of their ideals in the quickly disintegrating formerly socialist country.

Title: Luna de miel en familia
Stars: Roy Boulting, Hayley Mills, Avril Angers, John Comer
Description: Compassionate look at the troubles of two young newlyweds, whose marriage has yet to be consummated.

Title: Veloz como el viento
Stars: Stefano Accorsi, Matilda De Angelis, Paolo Graziosi
Description: Giulia es una joven promesa de las carreras GT. Cuando su vida se desmorona, su única esperanza es su hermano, un antiguo campeón de ralis con problemas de drogadicción.

Title: La vida invisible de Eurídice Gusmão
Stars: Julia Stockler, Carol Duarte, Flávia Gusmão
Description: Dos hermanas nacidas en Rio de Janeiro viven sus vidas cada una pensando que la otra tiene una vida de en sueño al otro lado del mundo.

Title: El niño que domó el viento
Stars: Chiwetel Ejiofor, Maxwell Simba, Felix Lemburo
Description: Un joven de Malawi ayuda a su gente a combatir la sequía construyendo una turbina eólica con un libro de la biblioteca escolar.

Title: Las mujeres de verdad tienen curvas
Stars: America Ferrera, Lupe Ontiveros, Ingrid Oliu
Description: En el este de Los Ángeles, una joven de 18 años se debate entre sus ambiciones de ir a la universidad y los deseos de su dominante madre de que se case.

Title: Infektionen
Stars: Magnus Krepper, Ruth Vega Fernandez, Pia Halvorsen
Description: Over the years, those small sticking points pervading Krister and Kristina Carnemos's marriage have filled them both with doubts over a future together.

Title: Honey Boy
Stars: Shia LaBeouf, Lucas Hedges, Noah Jupe
Description: Un niño actor intentan reparar su relación con su padre bebedor que a menudo se ha encontrado en el lado opuesto de la ley.

Title: Nosotros dos
Stars: Kevin Dowling, Jack Thompson, Russell Crowe, John Polson
Description: A widowed father has to deal with two complex issues: while he is searching for "Miss Right," his son, who is in his 20s and gay, is searching for "Mr. Right."

Title: National Theatre Live: Todos eran mis hijos
Stars: Ross MacGibbon, Bill Pullman, Jenna Coleman, Sally Field
Description: En América, en 1947, Joe y Kate Keller son un éxito; pero sus vidas están a punto de desmoronarse. Su pasado viene a pedirles cuentas y a acabar con su versión del sueño americano.

Title: Todos eran mis hijos
Stars: Edward G. Robinson, Burt Lancaster, Mady Christians
Description: Durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial, Joe Keller comete un delito e inculpa a su socio Herbert Deever, pero años más tarde su pecado vuelve a por él cuando descubre que su hijo planea casarse con la hija de Deever.

Title: El príncipe perdido
Stars: Matthew James Thomas, Rollo Weeks
Description: The story of Prince John, the autistic and epileptic youngest son of Queen Mary and King George V, who spent his whole life hidden away from public view and died at the age of 13 in 1919.

Title: Je vais bien, ne t'en fais pas
Stars: Kad Merad, Isabelle Renauld, Mélanie Laurent
Description: Lili returns from holidays and learns that her twin brother left the house after a violent argument with their father.

Title: Café Express
Stars: Nino Manfredi, Adolfo Celi, Vittorio Mezzogiorno
Description: Un trabajador italiano frustra a cualquiera que intente evitar que venda espresso en el tren de Milán a Nápoles.

Title: El ferroviario
Stars: Pietro Germi, Luisa Della Noce, Sylva Koscina
Description: The railroad engineer Andrea Marcocci has been working with his partner and friend Gigi Liverani for thirty years and feels happy and proud of his work, drinking wine after hours with his friends in a bar owned by the former railroad man Ugo. Andrea is married to Sara, and his young son Sandro is very close to him; however, Andrea has issues with his unemployed son Marcello and with his pregnant daughter Giulia, whose boyfriend Renato Borghi was forced to marry her. After a suicide crosses the tracks of his train in a curve, Andrea feels deeply affected by the accident and almost collides with another train. The railroad company investigates the accident and steps Andrea down from his position. The domestic life of Andrea is also affected by his aggressive behavior and Marcello and Giulia leave home. Later Andrea also leaves home and starts to drink until the day Sandro visits him in a bar.

Title: Khndzori aygin
Stars: Sos Sargsyan, Alla Tumanian, Azat Sherents
Description: An aged man falls in love with a woman refugee from Western Armenia. When his beloved dies because of his daughters, in a fury he destroys his only treasure - apple garden.

Title: El relevo
Stars: Dennis Christopher, Dennis Quaid, Daniel Stern
Description: Un chico de pueblo obsesionado con el equipo ciclista italiano compite por el cariño de una universitaria.

Title: Po glavnoy ulitse s orkestrom
Stars: Oleg Borisov, Lidiya Fedoseeva-Shukshina, Marina Zudina
Description: This probably happens for everyone: suddenly you want to drastically change your fate, start "from scratch", not waste your time on trifles, but walk "along the main street". The hero of the film is not limited to such thoughts, he decides to act: leaves the service, leaves the family .

Title: The Nest
Stars: Jude Law, Carrie Coon, Oona Roche
Description: El futuro de una familia se ve sumido en la incertidumbre tras mudarse de Estados Unidos a Inglaterra, ya que el tenso aislamiento de su nuevo hogar los afecta de manera diferente.

Title: Krotkaya
Stars: Iya Savvina, Andrei Popov, Vera Kuznetsova
Description: From lack of money, a girl without a dowry marries a usurer. But later she learns about her husband's past: about the circumstances under which he left the regiment. The meek one tries to rebel against life with her despised husband.

Title: National Theatre Live: The Lehman Trilogy
