Stars: Sam Mendes, Simon Russell Beale, Adam Godley, Ben Miles
Description: Los hermanos Lehman, desde sus inicios como corredores de algodón antes de la Guerra Civil hasta la implicación de la empresa en la crisis financiera de 2008.

Title: Monolog
Stars: Mikhail Gluzskiy, Margarita Terekhova, Marina Neyolova
Description: A professor of science dedicated to his work, but alienated from his personal life, struggles to reconcile with his estranged daughter.

Title: Stantsionnyy smotritel
Stars: Nikolai Pastukhov, Marianna Kushnerova, Nikita Mikhalkov
Description: In the early 19th century a traveler returns to the remote outpost he'd visited years before, anxious to see the station master's lovely daughter once again. There the brokenhearted old man tells him the story of the dashing fellow from Petersburg who whisked her away one winter morning.

Title: El aceite de la vida
Stars: Nick Nolte, Susan Sarandon, Peter Ustinov
Description: Un niño desarrolla una enfermedad tan rara que nadie está buscando una cura, por lo que su padre decide aprender todo al respecto y abordar el problema él mismo.

Title: Heart of a Lion
Stars: Peter Franzén, Laura Birn, Jasper Pääkkönen
Description: Un neonazi se enamora de una mujer que tiene un hijo negro y se encuentra luchando con sentimientos encontrados.

Title: La perla de la corona
Stars: Lucja Kowolik, Olgierd Lukaszewicz, Jan Englert
Description: The German owners of a mine decide that it is unprofitable and want to close it by flooding it. The miners go on strike.

Title: Historia de un matrimonio
Stars: Adam Driver, Scarlett Johansson, Julia Greer
Description: Un director de teatro y su mujer actriz lidian con su crudo divorcio desde ambas costas del país, explorando extremos tanto personales como profesionales.

Title: Little Fires Everywhere
Stars: Reese Witherspoon, Kerry Washington, Rosemarie DeWitt
Description: Basada en el libro del mismo nombre, sigue los destinos entrecruzados de la perfecta familia Richardson y un enigmático par madre-hija que cambia sus vidas.

Title: El glorioso caos de la vida
Stars: Eliza Scanlen, Michelle Lotters, Toby Wallace
Description: Milla, una adolescente gravemente enferma, se enamora de un traficante de drogas, Moses, la peor pesadilla de sus padres.

Title: La fuerza del cariño
Stars: Shirley MacLaine, Debra Winger, Jack Nicholson
Description: Sigue a la difícil Aurora, que busca el amor, y los problemas familiares de su hija.

Title: Mujercitas
Stars: Saoirse Ronan, Emma Watson, Florence Pugh
Description: Jo March reflexiona sobre su vida, contando la entrañable historia de las hermanas March: cuatro jóvenes, cada una de ellas decidida a vivir la vida en sus propios términos.

Title: Todos están bien
Stars: Robert De Niro, Kate Beckinsale, Sam Rockwell
Description: Un viudo que se dio cuenta de que su única conexión con su familia era a través de su esposa, emprende un viaje improvisado para reunirse con cada uno de sus hijos mayores.

Title: Patrik 1,5
Stars: Gustaf Skarsgård, Torkel Petersson, Tom Ljungman
Description: Una pareja gay sueca adopta a lo que creen que es un huérfano de 18 meses, sólo para conocer a su nuevo hijo, un delincuente homófobo de 15 años.

Title: La extraordinaria playlist de Zoey
Stars: Jane Levy, Skylar Astin, Alex Newell
Description: Una chica descubre que tiene la capacidad de escuchar los pensamientos más íntimos de las personas a su alrededor.

Title: Mambo Italiano
Stars: Luke Kirby, Ginette Reno, Paul Sorvino
Description: The son of Italian immigrants to Canada struggles to find the best way to reveal to his parents that he's gay.

Title: A propósito de Schmidt
Stars: Jack Nicholson, Kathy Bates, Hope Davis
Description: Un hombre recientemente jubilado se embarca en un viaje hacia la boda de su hija, solo para descubrir más sobre sí mismo y la vida de lo que esperaba.

Title: La maravillosa Sra. Maisel
Stars: Rachel Brosnahan, Alex Borstein, Michael Zegen
Description: Una ama de casa en la década de los 50 decide convertirse en monologuista cómica.

Title: Sé que sabes lo que sé
Stars: Alberto Sordi, Monica Vitti, Isabella De Bernardi
Description: A bank clerk rethinks his life after he learns the results of the surveillance of his family.

Title: Dear Ex
Stars: Mag Hsu, Roy Chiu, Ying-Hsuan Hsieh, Spark Chen
Description: A teenage boy and his mother are further driven apart when they find out that his father's life insurance policy is to be received by his lover.

Title: The Undoing
Stars: Nicole Kidman, Hugh Grant, Noah Jupe
Description: La vida de una terapeuta de éxito en Nueva York cambia tras los eventos que acontecen la víspera de la publicación de su primer libro.

Title: Hillbilly, una elegía rural
Stars: Amy Adams, Glenn Close, Gabriel Basso
Description: Un estudiante de derecho en Yale vuelve a su pueblo de los Apalaches y reflexiona sobre la historia de su familia y sobre su futuro. Basada en la biografía del mismo título.

Title: Obychnaya zhenshchina
Stars: Yuliya Melnikova, Tatyana Dogileva
Description: 39 years old Marina runs her own small business, a flower shop. She has a normal family with everyday worries. Everything about her life seems right, but behind this facade of success there are some terrible secrets lurking there.

Title: La innegable verdad
Stars: John Procaccino, Rob Huebel
Description: Dominick Birdsey, de mediana edad, recuerda su problemática relación con Thomas, su hermano gemelo con esquizofrenia paranoide, y sus intentos de sacarlo del manicomio.

Title: Wild Rose
Stars: Jessie Buckley, Matt Costello, Jane Patterson
Description: Una ex presidiaria, madre soltera en Glasgow sueña con convertirse en estrella de música country en Nashville.

Title: Chi to hone
Stars: Takeshi Kitano, Hirofumi Arai, Tomoko Tabata
Description: In 1923, the Korean teenager Kim Shun-Pei moves from Cheju Island, in South Korea, to Osaka, in Japan. Along the years, he becomes a cruel, greedy and violent man and builds a factory of kamaboko, processed seafood products, in his poor Korean-Japanese community exploiting his employees. He makes fortune, abuses and destroys the lives of his wife and family, having many mistresses and children and showing no respect to anybody. Later he closes the factory, lending the money with high interests and becoming a loan shark. His hatred behavior remains until his last breath, alone in North Korea.

Title: Kseniya, lyubimaya zhena Fyodora
Stars: Alla Meshcheryakova, Stanislav Lyubshin, Lev Durov

Title: El efecto de los rayos gamma sobre las margaritas
Stars: Joanne Woodward, Nell Potts, Roberta Wallach
Description: Beatrice, es una mujer desequilibrada, cuyas dos hijas son diametralmente opuestas: Ruth es una adolescente epiléptica y bastante alocada; Mathilda, la pequeña, es una excelente estudiante, muy inteligente y trabajadora.

Title: Viyon no tsuma
Stars: Takako Matsu, Tadanobu Asano, Shigeru Muroi
Description: This enticing period melodrama depicts a long-suffering woman's relationship with her brilliant but self-destructive writer husband in postwar Tokyo. Based on a semi-autobiographical 1947 novel by Osamu Dazai, the story centers less on the womanizing, heavy-drinking, suicidal hero than on the wife who loves him.

Title: Iris
Stars: Kate Winslet, Hugh Bonneville, Judi Dench
Description: La verdadera historia del romance entre la novelista Iris Murdoch y su esposo John Bayley, desde sus días de estudiante hasta su batalla contra el Alzheimer.

Title: Oraciones para Bobby
Stars: Sigourney Weaver, Henry Czerny, Ryan Kelley
Description: True story of Mary Griffith, gay rights crusader, whose teenage son committed suicide due to her religious intolerance. Based on the book of the same title by Leroy Aarons.

Title: Serenata nostálgica
Stars: Irene Dunne, Cary Grant, Beulah Bondi
Description: Los grandes sueños de una pareja dan paso a una vida llena de tristezas imprevistas y alegrías inesperadas.

Title: El orden divino
Stars: Marie Leuenberger, Maximilian Simonischek, Rachel Braunschweig
Description: En 1971, una joven ama de casa organiza a las mujeres de su pueblo para reclamar su derecho al voto.

Title: Sado
Stars: Song Kang-ho, Yoo Ah-in, Moon Geun-young
Description: Set in 18th century Korea, long-ruling King Yeongjo's struggle with his son, Sado, sees the king take extreme measures in order to deal with his heir.

Title: Después del amor
Stars: Albert Finney, Diane Keaton, Karen Allen
Description: Una madre de cuatro hijos es abandonada por su marido por una mujer más joven.

Title: El muchacho
Stars: Fumio Watanabe, Akiko Koyama, Tetsuo Abe
Description: A young boy reluctantly aids his swindling father in a threatening scam.

Title: El vídeo de Benny
Stars: Arno Frisch, Angela Winkler, Ulrich Mühe
Description: Un entusiasta del video de 14 años está tan atrapado en la fantasía del cine que ya no puede relacionarse con el mundo real, hasta tal punto que comete un asesinato y graba una confesión en cámara para sus padres.

Title: Maudie: El color de la vida
Stars: Sally Hawkins, Zachary Bennett, Gabrielle Rose
Description: Una mujer artrítica de Nueva Escocia trabaja de empleada doméstica mientras perfecciona sus habilidades como artista y finalmente se convierte en una figura muy querida en la comunidad.

Title: En este rincón del mundo
Stars: Non, Ava Pickard, Kenna Pickard
Description: Ambientada en Hiroshima durante la segunda guerra mundial, una chica recién casada intenta preparar comida para su familia a pesar del racionamiento, y lucha por mantener la voluntad de vivir a pesar de la falta de comodidades básicas.

Title: Dnevnik ego zheny
Stars: Andrey Smirnov, Galina Tyunina, Olga Budina
Description: An attempt to fathom the personal life of the great Russian writer Ivan Bunin.

Title: Los indiferentes
Stars: Claudia Cardinale, Rod Steiger, Shelley Winters
Description: Una condesa sin dinero se enamora de un truhan, sin saber que él tiene una relación con su hija.

Title: Poprygunya
Stars: Sergey Bondarchuk, Lyudmila Tselikovskaya, Vladimir Druzhnikov
Description: Osip Ivanovich Dymov, the titular counselor and the doctor of thirty one years, serves in two hospitals at the same time: intern and anatomist. From nine o'clock in the morning and in the forenoon accepts patients, then goes to open corpses. But its income is hardly enough for a covering of expenses of the wife mad about talents and celebrities in the art and artistic environment whom it daily accepts in the house.

Title: Kochankowie mojej mamy
Stars: Krystyna Janda, Rafal Wegrzyniak, Hanna Skarzanka
Description: Rafal takes care of his dysfunctional carefree mother who is more interested in men, pills and alcohol than in the problems of her young yet very mature son.

Title: Nowhere Boy
Stars: Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Kristin Scott Thomas, David Threlfall
Description: Una crónica de los primeros años de John Lennon, centrada principalmente en su adolescencia y su relación con su severa tía Mimi.

Title: Tri Sestry
Stars: Irina Miroshnichenko, Vladlen Davydov, Yelena Kondratova
Description: Chekhov's immortal classic about three sisters who live in a provincial town, in 19th century Russia, but dream of going back to Moscow and rewriting their own story.

Title: El padre
Stars: Olivia Colman, Anthony Hopkins, Mark Gatiss
Description: Un hombre rechaza toda la ayuda de su hija a medida que envejece. Mientras intenta comprender lo que ocurre a su alrededor, comienza a dudar de sus seres queridos, de su mente e incluso de su propia realidad.

Title: La corrupción
Stars: Alain Cuny, Rosanna Schiaffino, Jacques Perrin
Description: The son of a rich Italian industrialist finds out how tough it is to leave the path society has set for him.

Title: La costa de los mosquitos
Stars: Harrison Ford, Helen Mirren, River Phoenix
Description: Un inventor deja atrás su vida en la ciudad y traslada a su familia a las selvas de América Central para crear una utopía.

Title: My Father My Lord
Stars: Assi Dayan, Ilan Griff, Sharon Hacohen
Description: A respected rabbi is forced to come to terms with the demands of his faith and the welfare of his own family.

Title: Skazhi ey
Stars: Kai Aleks Getts, Svetlana Khodchenkova, Artyom Bystrov
Description: When his parents divorce and his mother moves to the United States, 11-year -old Sasha of St. Petersburg, Russia is pulled apart emotionally between two parents, both of whom he loves, and two cultures.

Title: Sufat Chol
Stars: Lamis Ammar, Ruba Blal, Hitham Omari
Description: Cuando toda su vida se rompe, dos mujeres beduinas luchan por cambiar las reglas inmutables, cada una a su manera.

Title: La boda de Rachel
Stars: Sebastian Stan, Roslyn Ruff, Anne Hathaway
Description: Una joven que ha estado entrando y saliendo de rehabilitación durante los últimos diez años, vuelve a casa durante el fin de semana para la boda de su hermana.

Title: Fanny
Stars: Raimu, Pierre Fresnay, Fernand Charpin
Description: After Fanny's boyfriend leaves her and sails away, she finds out she's pregnant.

Title: Bienvenido al paraíso
Stars: Dennis Quaid, Tamlyn Tomita, Sab Shimono
Description: Segunda Guerra Mundial (1939-1945). Narra una historia de amor que se desarrolla en los campos de concentración para japoneses que se crearon en Estados Unidos tras el ataque japonés contra la base naval de Pearl Harbor (1941).

Title: Años difíciles
Stars: Umberto Spadaro, Ave Ninchi, Enzo Biliotti
Description: Aldo Piscitello, a minor government clerk, is forced in 1934 to join the Fascist party. When the war comes, he finds himself able only to talk ineffectually in secret against Mussolini, even as his own son Giovanni is sent into battle. By the end of the war, Aldo has found the courage to stand up for his beliefs, but by then it is too late.

Title: Esau
Stars: Lior Ashkenazi, Mark Ivanir, Yuliya Peresild
Description: Un escritor de 40 años regresa a la casa de su familia de la cual escapó cuando joven, para enfrentar a su hermano, quien heredó la panadería de su familia y se casó con la mujer que ambos amaban.

Title: Luces rojas
Stars: Jean-Pierre Darroussin, Carole Bouquet, Vincent Deniard
Description: Antoine y Helene viajan al sur de Francia para recoger a sus hijos de un campamento de vacaciones. El tráfico es denso y el ambiente cada vez más tenso; él es alcohólico y se emborracha cada vez más cuanto más se detienen.

Title: Portret zheny khudozhnika
Stars: Valentina Telichkina, Sergey Shakurov, Nikita Mikhalkov
Description: Artist Pavel Alekseevich and his wife Nina spend their holidays in a small boarding house. For him, it is an opportunity to collect thoughts and paint a new picture. Nina has an affair with another man .

Title: CODA: Los sonidos del silencio
Stars: Emilia Jones, Troy Kotsur, Daniel Durant
Description: Como hija de adultos sordos, Ruby es la única persona oyente en su familia. Cuando el negocio pesquero de la familia se ve amenazado, Ruby se encuentra dividida entre perseguir su amor por la música y su miedo a abandonar a sus padres.

Title: El jardín colgante
Stars: Ian Parsons, Peter MacNeill, Troy Veinotte
Description: William, a once obese and depressed adolescent, is able to move past his teenage years when he moves to the city and comes out as being gay. When he returns home though, he can't cope with his memories.

Title: El Skylab
Stars: Bernadette Lafont, Emmanuelle Riva, Eric Elmosnino
Description: In July 1979, during the Summer holidays, in a house somewhere in Brittany, a whole family (parents, uncles, aunts, cousins and other relatives) are gathered to celebrate Granny Amandine's sixty-seventh birthday. Albertine, who was ten years old at the time, vividly recounts this brief but life-changing experience.

Title: Árbol sin hojas
Stars: Keiju Kobayashi, Nobuko Otowa, Ichirô Zaitsu
Description: Haru, an aging scriptwriter, has isolated himself somewhere in the woods of Nagano to work on his first novel. As the last surviving member of his kin, he intends to chronicle the family he grew up in.

Title: Tato
Stars: Boguslaw Linda, Dorota Segda, Ola Maliszewska
Description: A father, who is in the middle of a brutal custody battle with his mentally ill wife, fights relentlessly for the right to take care of his 7-year-old daughter.

Title: Las llaves de casa
Stars: Kim Rossi Stuart, Andrea Rossi, Charlotte Rampling
Description: Meeting his disabled son for the first time, a young father attempts to forge a relationship with the teenager.

Title: Hanaoka Seishû no tsuma
Stars: Raizô Ichikawa, Ayako Wakao, Hideko Takamine
Description: The Wife of Seishû Hanaoka is set in feudal Japan. Its two central characters are based on the wife and mother of Japanese physician Seishû Hanaoka (1760-1835). Hanaoka developed a herbal general anesthetic, "Tsusensan", some forty years before the better-known innovations of his American counterparts Long, Wells and Morton.

Title: Oy, vy, gusi...
Stars: Vyacheslav Sobolev, Yuri Bobrov, Vasili Frolov
Description: The backbone of the story is the daily life of Mitka, whose health is so poor he is not allowed to work. Instead, his wife Raya supports him, despite her heart condition. Nearby lives brother Petka, another impecunious man, who is amusingly tiny when compared to his strong, solid wife: she earns their living as a nurse in a retirement home. Brother Sanya has been in a prison camp for committing murder, and he is only now returning home to join his other brothers.

Title: Vasiliy i Vasilisa
Stars: Olga Ostroumova, Mikhail Kononov, Natalya Bondarchuk

Title: Secretos de un matrimonio
Stars: Jessica Chastain, Oscar Isaac, Sophia Kopera
Description: Revisa la icónica idea de I. Bergman del amor, el odio, el deseo, la monogamia, el matrimonio y el divorcio desde la perspectiva de una pareja estadounidense contemporánea.

Title: Asia
Stars: Alena Yiv, Shira Haas, Tamir Mula
Description: La maternidad de Asia siempre ha sido una lucha constante más que un instinto obvio.

Title: Hope
Stars: Andrea Bræin Hovig, Stellan Skarsgård, Elli Rhiannon Müller Osborne
Description: La relación entre los artistas-socios Tomas y Anja se pone a prueba después de que Anja recibe un diagnóstico que amenaza su vida.

Title: Years and Years
Stars: Anne Reid, Rory Kinnear, Jessica Hynes
Description: La trama sigue a una familia trabajadora de Manchester.

Title: Solino
Stars: Barnaby Metschurat, Moritz Bleibtreu, Christian Tasche
Description: In the sixties Romano Amato, his wife Rosa and their two sons Giancarlo and Gigi emigrate from Solino in Italy to Duisburg in the Ruhr area and establish the first Pizza restaurant in town. Their business emerges well and both children get used to Germany. 10 years later the brothers fall in love with the same woman; they break tie with each other in anger and Gigi returns to Solino with his mother. A decade later both meet again and have a retrospect on their lives.

Title: Tributo
Stars: Jack Lemmon, Robby Benson, Lee Remick
Description: Un superficial agente de prensa de Broadway se entera de que se está muriendo justo cuando el hijo de su exesposa llega de visita.

Title: Banquete de bodas
Stars: Bette Davis, Ernest Borgnine, Debbie Reynolds
Description: Cuando Jane comunica a sus padres que va a casarse con Ralph Halloran, su madre Agnes comienza a planear una elaborada boda, a pesar de que Jane no lo desea.

Title: Liberty Heights
Stars: Adrien Brody, Ben Foster, Orlando Jones
Description: Baltimore, Fall 1954: Schools implement the new integration law. Ben finds the "colored" girl in his class cute - upsetting his Jewish mom and granny. Ben talks to her while his brother looks for his WASP dream girl.

Title: Pochka
Stars: Irina Rozanova, Aleksey Rozin
Description: Fire inspector Natalya Kustova profits from every inspection. She'll exploit anyone for money, even family. She believes everything's for sale - friendships, homes, luxury goods, and love.

Title: Uno de nosotros
Stars: Diane Lane, Kevin Costner, Kayli Carter
Description: Un sheriff jubilado y su mujer, en luto tras la pérdida de su hijo, van a encontrarse con su único nieto.

Title: Cuatro pasos por las nubes
Stars: Gino Cervi, Adriana Benetti, Giuditta Rissone
Description: A family man travelling for work, Paolo Bianchi, meets on a train a lonely girl, Maria. He sees her again on a bus and she reveals him that she's in troubles: she's pregnant, her baby's father has left her and she doesn't know how to tell to her parents that she's not married. She asks Paolo to play the role of her husband and he accepts....

Title: La Segunda Mujer
Stars: Nihal G. Koldas, Begüm Akkaya, Vedat Erincin
Description: Ayse is wed to Hasan, the handsome son of house-proud mother Fatma. Ayse is whisked away to Vienna where she soon finds that the marriage is a sham and she is to be the second wife to Fatma's husband.

Title: Una vida mejor
Stars: Demián Bichir, Eddie 'Piolin' Sotelo, Joaquín Cosio
Description: Un jardinero en el este de Los Ángeles lucha por mantener a su hijo alejado de las pandillas y los agentes de inmigración mientras trata de darle a su hijo las oportunidades que nunca tuvo.

Title: La voz de la montaña
Stars: Setsuko Hara, Sô Yamamura, Ken Uehara
Description: An ingratiating bride develops warm ties to her father-in-law while her cold husband blithely slights her for another woman.

Title: Yo maté a mi madre
Stars: Anne Dorval, Xavier Dolan, François Arnaud
Description: La historia semibiográfica de Hubert, un adolescente homosexual con una mala relación con su madre.

Title: Den mertvykh
Stars: Aleksandr Pal, Agrippina Steklova
Description: On Parents' Saturday, the ancestors' memorial day, a mother and her son travel in an old Sedan. They have to visit five cemeteries, scattered across the region.

Title: El sureño
Stars: Zachary Scott, Betty Field, J. Carrol Naish
Description: Los Tucker, una familia pobre de jornaleros del algodón, decide comprar su propio terreno, pero la naturaleza está en su contra.

Title: Insiang
Stars: Hilda Koronel, Mona Lisa, Rez Cortez
Description: The life of a young girl living with her mother in the slums of Manila becomes unbearable when her mother's young boyfriend moves in with them.

Title: Mamá está en la peluquería
Stars: Marianne Fortier, Élie Dupuis, Hugo St-Onge-Paquin
Description: Élise's family fractures when her mother departs. Coco immerses himself in car repairs, Benoît withdraws, their father adrift. Élise becomes the unifying force during a trans-formative summer surrounded by nature's splendor.

Title: Ya tebya nenavizhu
Stars: Svetlana Kryuchkova, Yuriy Kuznetsov, Yelena Polyakova
Description: The plot is based on the story of a meeting and reconciliation after many years of separation of the Mikhailovs, the realization of a mistake they made in their youth. Once they were too lazy to understand each other. He left for the construction site in a hurry, and she, having accepted his departure, did not forget the offense. A few years later, the hero came to his wife and grown-up daughter.

Title: Boyhood. Momentos de una vida
Stars: Ellar Coltrane, Patricia Arquette, Elijah Smith
Description: La vida de Mason, desde la primera infancia hasta su llegada a la universidad.

Title: El demonio
Stars: Shima Iwashita, Ken Ogata, Hiroki Iwase
Description: Un hombre casado deja de cuidar de su amante y ella abandona a sus tres hijos pequeños con él y su iracunda esposa.

Title: Hasta siempre, hijo mío
Stars: Jingchun Wang, Mei Yong, Xi Qi
Description: Dos matrimonios se ajustan a los enormes cambios sociales y económicos que tienen lugar en China desde los 80 hasta hoy.

Title: Rosie
Stars: Sibylle Brunner, Fabian Krüger, Judith Hofmann
Description: Lorenz Meran, (40) a successful gay author suffering acute writers' block, has to leave Berlin and return to eastern Switzerland to provide care for his aged mother, Rosie. When he finds himself confronted with the fact that fun-loving Rosie refuses both outside assistance and a care home, he discovers that he is stuck fast in his small home town of Altstätten. But it is not only his mother's battle against being dictated to and losing her dignity that he is struggling with. It's also his own midlife crisis. And when long-kept secrets are suddenly revealed under the tensions of family dynamics, Lorenz almost fails to notice that love is knocking on the front door of his parent's house...

Title: Hongse kanbaiyin
Stars: Lu Huang, Yulai Lü, Anlian Yao
Description: A father and son meet after five years of the father's absence and they go on a trip to rebuild their relationship.

Title: Otôto
Stars: Keiko Kishi, Hiroshi Kawaguchi, Kinuyo Tanaka
Description: Set in 1926 when Japanese tradition was much stronger, this standard drama looks at the inner workings of a small family, especially the relationship between a sister and brother.

Title: Thua me con di
Stars: Hong Dao, Lanh Thanh, Vo Dien Gia Huy
Description: Nau Van returns home several years after staying in America on the anniversary of his father's death to meet his family. Unbeknownst to them, he returns with his long-term boyfriend, Ian.

Title: Todo o nada
Stars: Alison Garland, Jean Ainslie, Timothy Spall
Description: In a poor working class London home, Penny's love for her partner, taxi driver Phil, has run dry. When an unexpected tragedy occurs, they and their local community are brought back together.

Title: Pozdniye svidaniya
Stars: Larisa Malevannaya, Yuri Platonov, Yekaterina Vasilyeva
Description: Pozdnie Svidaniya (aka...'Late Rendezvous') is a story of a career woman in a midlife crisis.

Title: Meshchane
Stars: Evgeniy Lebedev, Mariya Prizvan-Sokolova, Emma Popova

Title: Juramento hipocrático
Stars: Meryl Streep, Fred Ward, Seth Adkins
Description: The story of one woman's struggle against a narrow-minded medical establishment.

Title: Mandy
Stars: Phyllis Calvert, Jack Hawkins, Terence Morgan
Description: Mandy Garland was born deaf and has been mute for all of her life. Her parents believe she is able to speak if she can only be taught, and they enroll her with a special teacher.

Title: Golden Voices
Stars: Mariya Belkina, Vladimir Friedman, Evelin Hagoel
Description: Raya and Victor have built a shared career as the Soviet Union's most beloved film voice actors. As the USSR collapses, the Jewish couple must immigrate to Israel and reinvent themselves to find new jobs.

Title: Plotnik
Stars: Sofya Bagrationi, Margarita Bychkova, Aleksey Filimonov
Description: The Osipovs are a simple, friendly and very happy family from Ulyanovsk. The sudden illness of a young son turns their life full of rainbow plans upside down. Parents are ready to do anything to save their child. But fate puts before them more and more new obstacles, from which anyone would break. But not just him. The most ordinary person. Provincial carpenter.

Title: Todo ha ido bien
Stars: Sophie Marceau, André Dussollier, Géraldine Pailhas
Description: Cuando André, de 85 años, sufre un derrame cerebral, Emmanuelle se apresura a ir junto a la cama de su padre. Enfermo y medio paralizado en su cama de hospital, le pide a Emmanuelle que lo ayude a terminar con su vida.

Title: National Theatre Live: Hansard
Stars: Robin Lough, Rowena Bentley, Lindsay Duncan, Alex Jennings
Description: On a summer's morning in 1988, a Tory politician and his wife begin to dig up buried secrets.

Title: Otoño tardío
Stars: Setsuko Hara, Yôko Tsukasa, Mariko Okada
Description: Una viuda intenta casar a su hija con la ayuda de los amigos de su difunto marido.

Title: Onna no za
Stars: Hideko Takamine, Yôko Tsukasa, Yuriko Hoshi
Description: Drama about the lives of the five daughters and daughter-in-law of a store owner.

Title: Melochi zhizni
Stars: Olga Ostroumova, Anatoliy Grachyov, Aleksandr Vokach

Title: Alma en suplicio
Stars: Joan Crawford, Jack Carson, Zachary Scott
Description: Una madre trabajadora se acerca al desastre mientras se divorcia de su esposo y comienza un exitoso negocio de restaurantes para mantener a su hija mimada.

Title: Fågelfångarens son
Stars: Rudi Køhnke, Vígdis Eliesersdóttir Hentze Bjørck, Livia Millhagen
Description: It's the late 1800s and the birdcatcher Esmar and his wife Johanna are trying to survive on the harsh dramatic cliffs of the Faroe Islands. Local law dictates that unless they have a son, an heir to the hold on their land, they will be evicted. When Johanna gives birth to their third daughter, with time on the lease running out, they become desperate. A friend, innkeeper Livia, suggests that the only way for Johanna to have a son might be to be impregnated by another man. It's unthinkable, but they are pushed to the brink. When they employ Livia's lover, the "French Captain" to do the deed, none of. them can understand the ultimate consequences of their choices.

Title: El zoo de cristal
Stars: Joanne Woodward, John Malkovich, Karen Allen
Description: A son longs to escape from his stifling home, where his genteel mother worries about the future prospects of his lame, shy sister.

Title: Lejos de ella
Stars: Julie Christie, Michael Murphy, Gordon Pinsent
Description: Un hombre que enfrenta la institucionalización de su esposa debido a la enfermedad de Alzheimer se enfrenta a una epifanía cuando ella transfiere sus afectos a otro hombre.

Title: Te doy mis ojos
Stars: Laia Marull, Luis Tosar, Candela Peña
Description: Pilar huye de casa una noche de invierno. Solo se lleva con ella unas pocas pertenencias y a su hijo, Juan. Antonio no tarda en empezar a buscarla. Dice que Pilar es su sol y que, además, "le ha dado sus ojos...".

Title: La hija de un soldado nunca llora
Stars: Kris Kristofferson, Barbara Hershey, Leelee Sobieski
Description: This fictionalized story, based on the family life of writer James Jones, is an emotionless slice-of-life story. Jones here is portrayed as Bill Willis, a former war hero and now successful author who obviously drinks too much and is starting to experience health problems.

Title: Nada como el hogar
Stars: Christine Lahti, Jeff Daniels, Scott Marlowe
Description: La impactante historia del doloroso descenso de una familia a la tragedia económica de la falta de vivienda.

Title: La llave
Stars: Machiko Kyô, Ganjirô Nakamura, Junko Kanô
Description: A man getting on in years sets out to find a way to resurrect his flagging virility.

Title: El padre de familia
Stars: Nino Manfredi, Leslie Caron, Claudine Auger
Description: Two architects meet some time after World War II and get married. Though they are deeply in love, they come from different backgrounds and do not share the same outlooks on life. Soon she becomes fascinated with his progressive socialist ideals.

Title: Joyland
Stars: Ali Junejo, Rasti Farooq, Alina Khan
Description: Mientras familia Rana anhela el nacimiento de un bebé, el más joven de los hombres, se une en secreto a un teatro erótico y se enamora de una estrella trans. Su historia de amor ilumina el deseo de rebelión sexual de toda la familia Rana.

Title: Vash syn i brat
Stars: Vsevolod Sanaev, Leonid Kuravlyov, Anastasia Filippova
Description: Old Yermolai Voevodin lives in a Siberian village. He has four sons and a daughter. But how different were their destinies. The eldest, Ignat, went to Moscow, began to perform in the circus, demonstrating remarkable strength. He is satisfied with his life and with his stories lures his brother Maxim to the city. He gets a job as a laborer at a construction site, but he constantly feels his loneliness. In his thoughts he does not break with the village, but pride prevents him from returning. The middle son, Stepan, is a man of irrepressible character, fought "for the truth" and ended up in prison. Three months before his release, he escapes and returns to the village to see his relatives, walk the earth and, as he says, gain strength to serve his sentence. In the village with his father, only his favorite Vasily and the mute Verka remain. Yermolai is having a hard time with the breakup of his family, passionately dreams of gathering all his sons under the roof of his house, but will his dream come true?

Title: Murina
Stars: Gracija Filipovic, Leon Lucev, Danica Curcic
Description: Julija es una adolecente determinada y con deseo de libertad, pero sufre con la opresión de su padre. Cuando un amigo de familia les visita, ella ve una posibilidad de cambio.

Title: Más fuerte que la vida
Stars: Joanne Woodward, Sheree North, Tony Randall
Description: En California, cuatro parejas han comprado casas cercanas una de la otra, enfrentan problemas de alcoholismo, racismo, promiscuidad y discriminación, hasta que un trágico acontecimiento les obliga a reevaluar sus vidas.

Title: Mi familia
Stars: Edward James Olmos, Rafael Cortes, Ivette Reina
Description: Un hombre se dirige desde México a Los Ángeles en la década de 1920, donde se casa y cría una gran familia.

Title: The Cry
Stars: Ewen Leslie, Asher Keddie
Description: Sigue a Joanna y Alistair cuya capacidad como padres será cuestionada y su relación de pareja comenzará a desintegrarse después de que su hijo Noah desaparece en extrañas circunstancias mientras se dirigían a la ciudad de Geelong.

Title: Chuang ru zhe
Stars: Zhong Lü, Yuanzheng Feng, Hailu Qin
Description: Deng is a stubborn retired widow who spends her days caring about her two grown up sons and her elderly mother, despite her family efforts to stop her. But her daily routine starts derailing when she keeps receiving anonymous calls..

Title: Colgados en Beverly Hills
Stars: Natasha Lyonne, Alan Arkin, Bryna Weiss
Description: In 1976, a lower-middle-class teenager struggles to cope living with her neurotic family of nomads on the outskirts of Beverly Hills.

Title: Amparo
Stars: Sandra Melissa Torres, Diego Alejandro Tobón, Luciana Gallego
Description: En 1998, la madre soltera Amparo, se apresura a salvar a su hijo adolescente, después de que es reclutado y desplegado al servicio del ejército colombiano.

Title: Todos lo saben
Stars: Penélope Cruz, Javier Bardem, Ricardo Darín
Description: Laura, una española que vive en Buenos Aires, regresa a su Madrid natal son sus hijos para asistir a la boda de su hermana.

Title: El caftán azul
Stars: Lubna Azabal, Saleh Bakri, Ayoub Missioui
Description: Halim y Mina tienen una tienda de caftán en una de las medinas más antiguas de Marruecos. Para mantenerse al día, contratan a un joven como aprendiz. Lentamente, Mina se da cuenta de lo conmovido que está su marido por su presencia.

Title: The Quiet Girl
Stars: Carrie Crowley, Andrew Bennett, Catherine Clinch
Description: Irlanda rural 1981. Una niña tranquila y abandonada es enviada lejos de su familia disfuncional para vivir con unos padres adoptivos durante el verano. Ella florece bajo su cuidado, pero en esta casa descubre un secreto.

Title: Hit the Road
Stars: Pantea Panahiha, Mohammad Hassan Madjooni, Rayan Sarlak
Description: Una familia tierna y caótica está en un viaje por carretera a través de un paisaje accidentado. Solo el misterioso hermano mayor está callado.

Title: Ne gledaj mi u pijat
Stars: Mia Petricevic, Niksa Butijer, Arijana Culina
Description: Cuando el autoritario padre de Marijana cae gravemente enfermo, ella asumirá el rol de jefa de familia. Esta nueva dinámica le dará libertad y deberá aprender a balancear su vida con sus responsabilidades.

Title: El marido
Stars: Fernando Palacios, Gianni Puccini, Alberto Sordi, Aurora Bautista, Luigi Tosi
Description: Alberto's marriage is a complete failure: his wife Elena is a hard woman influenced by her mother and sister who live with the married couple. Alberto is also experiencing financial problems and hopes for the help of a rich widow who is however interested in his sexual favours. Naturally Elena puts obstacles in his way and everything goes wrong. Alberto decides to change job then and becomes a sweets sales representative. Disillusioned with marital life he also changes his attitude towards women: he tells every woman he meets he is single.

Title: La vida es un largo río tranquilo
Stars: Benoît Magimel, Hélène Vincent, Valérie Lalande
Description: A revengeful nurse switches a girl and a boy at birth. They are raised in two radically different families. When the switch is revealed many years later, the now teenagers and families need to cope with their new environments.

Title: Los Fabelman
Stars: Michelle Williams, Paul Dano, Seth Rogen
Description: Al crecer en la era de Arizona posterior a la Segunda Guerra Mundial, un joven llamado Sammy Fabelman descubre un secreto familiar devastador y explora cómo el poder de las películas puede ayudarlo a ver la verdad.

Title: A Friend of the Family
Stars: Jake Lacy, Colin Hanks, Lio Tipton
Description: Cuenta la desgarradora historia real de la familia Broberg, cuya hija Jan fue secuestrada varias veces durante un período de años por un "amigo" de la familia.

Title: Uzly
Stars: Tamara Balkarova, Alim Khokonov, Svetlana Mamresheva
Description: Bird, an adult trucker, marries seventeen-year-old Dina. They build the largest house in the village, which eventually turns into an impregnable fortress.

Title: Svinalängorna
Stars: Noomi Rapace, Ola Rapace, Outi Mäenpää
Description: Una joven crece durante la década de 1970 en una casa llena de abusos y alcoholismo.

Title: Hilary y Jackie
Stars: Emily Watson, Rachel Griffiths, James Frain
Description: The tragic story of world renowned classic cellist Jacqueline du Pré, as told from the point of view of her sister, flautist Hilary du Pré-Finzi.

Title: Afrikanych
Stars: Oleg Belov, Irina Bunina, Larisa Burkova
Description: Ivan Afrikanych is struggling to support his wife, Katerina, and their seven children.

Title: Pominalnaya molitva
Stars: Yuriy Makhayev, Mark Zakharov, Aleksandr Abdulov, Ivan Agapov, Lyudmila Artemeva

Title: Shi no toge
Stars: Keiko Matsuzaka, Ittoku Kishibe, Midori Kiuchi
Description: Period drama set in the 1950's about a couple isolating themselves from the outside world as they attempt to salvage their faltering marriage, no matter what the costs, after the husband has an affair.

Title: Wo he ba ba
Stars: Jinglei Xu, Daying Ye, Kun Hu
Description: After Xiao Yu's mother died in an accident, she moved back to live with her birth father who she knows little about. Gradually, they grew to know each other and to accept each other for who they are. They share the unconditional love between a daughter and a father through their happiness and their difficulties.

Title: Una familia de Tokio
Stars: Isao Hashizume, Kazuko Yoshiyuki, Masahiko Nishimura
Description: Un profesor jubilado y su esposa visitan a sus tres hijos en Tokio, donde trabajan.

Title: Vremya goda zima
Stars: Igor Andreev, Vladimir Artyomov, Aleksandra Babaskina
Description: The relationship between Katya and her mother cannot be called simple anyway, and then, at the height of the working day, Katya finds out that her mother never flew with her friend to the resort, having disappeared from the airport in an unknown direction. Having learned from the doctor the real reason for her mother's strange behavior, Katya not only reunites with her, but also discovers a lot of new things about her mother and about herself.

Title: Más que nunca
Stars: Vicky Krieps, Gaspard Ulliel, Bjørn Floberg
Description: Hélène y Mathieu han sido felices juntos durante muchos años. El vínculo entre ellos es profundo. Ante una decisión existencial, Hélène viaja sola a Noruega para buscar la paz y conocer a un bloguero que encontró en Internet.

Title: Anatomía de una caída
Stars: Sandra Hüller, Swann Arlaud, Milo Machado-Graner
Description: Una mujer es sospechosa del asesinato de su marido, y el hijo ciego de ambos se enfrenta a un dilema moral como único testigo.

Title: Cómo meterse en un jardín
Stars: Olivia Colman, David Thewlis, Kate O'Flynn
Description: Una pareja británica dedicada y afable se convierte en el centro de una investigación extraordinaria cuando se descubren dos cadáveres en el jardín trasero de una casa en Inglaterra.

Title: Den pro mou lásku
Stars: Marta Vancurová, Vlastimil Harapes, Sylva Kamenická
Description: The young married couple - photographer Marie (Marta Vancurová) and civil engineering student Petr (Vlastimil Harapes) - live in a cozy attic flat with their four-year-old daughter Maruska. Petr sometimes goes out for a beer with other students and one night brings a couple of them - hungry and loud - back home with him in early morning hours, much to Marie's discontent. But the two young people have a strong and loving relationship and when Maruska suddenly falls ill they are very distressed.

Title: Alisa ne mozhet zhdat
Stars: Anna Mikhalkova, Elizaveta Ishchenko
Description: Alyssa de 15 años se entera de que pronto se quedará ciega. Promete vivir al máximo mientras pueda y decide que sería estúpido perder el tiempo en la escuela.

Title: Scrapper
Stars: Lola Campbell, Alin Uzun, Cary Crankson
Description: Georgie, una soñadora niña de 12 años, vive felizmente sola en su piso de Londres, llenándolo de magia. De repente, aparece su padre, del que está separada, y la obliga a enfrentarse a la realidad.

Title: Bonnard, el pintor y su musa
Stars: Cécile de France, Vincent Macaigne, Stacy Martin
Description: La vida del pintor francés Pierre Bonnard y su esposa, Marthe de Méligny, a lo largo de cinco décadas.

Title: Beri da pomni
Stars: Rabit Batulla, Nurbek Batullin, Siren Bayramov
Description: 70-year-old Rasim plays a wish-granting game with his grandson to conceal his parents' death. Initially opposed by wife Sufiya, the game transforms their family, village life, and dreams remarkably.

Title: Samanishvilis dedinatsvali
Stars: Vasil Kakhniashvili, Berta Khapava, Imedo Kakhiani
Description: Impoverished old nobleman Bekina insists on marrying a wife, but his son Platon does not want to have sharer in father's inheritance. Platon finds two times widowed and childless bride for Bekina, but a fate makes fun of him.

Title: Na iskhode leta
Stars: Vladimir Borisov, Igor Dmitriev, Andrey Dudarenko

Title: Neadekvatnye lyudi 2
Stars: Ingrid Olerinskaya, Evgeniy Tsyganov, Mariya Goryacheva
Description: How to adequately get out of the crisis after 10 years of relations. Sequel to Roman Karimov's romantic comedy.

Title: Podmoskovnaya elegiya
Stars: Mikhail Ulyanov, Ada Rogovtseva, Irina Kupchenko
Description: Old age tends to dispel illusions. The famous actor Sergei Cherkassky lived his life honestly and was always true to his principles. But now the world outside the cottage in Peredelkino is completely incomprehensible to him, and his own children and grandchildren are completely unwilling to make his dreams come true..

Title: Ibo kyoudai
Stars: Rentarô Mikuni, Kinuyo Tanaka, Chôko Iida
Description: In a military family, an illegitimate son is brutalized by his brothers. A patriarchal, feudalistic household where dissent is forbidden is used to reveal the whole imperialist system that afflicted Japan between 1921 and 1946.

Title: Kong que
Stars: Jing An, Li Feng, Changwei Gu
Description: China in the late 1970s and early 1980s: the life of an ordinary working family as seen through its three siblings.

Title: Vuelve pequeña Sheba
Stars: Burt Lancaster, Shirley Booth, Terry Moore
Description: Basada en la obra clásica de William Inge, Come Back, Little Sheba es la conmovedora historia de una pareja desgastada por la vida que recupera la ilusión.

Title: Tenemos que hablar de Kevin
Stars: Tilda Swinton, John C. Reilly, Ezra Miller
Description: A la madre de Kevin le cuesta querer a su peculiar hijo, que dice y hace más cosas peligrosas cuanto más mayor se hace.

Title: Las tres hijas
Stars: Carrie Coon, Natasha Lyonne, Elizabeth Olsen
Description: Tres hermanas adultas que se reúnen para cuidar a su padre enfermo con cáncer y alcanzando sus últimos días de vida.

Title: Ghostlight
Stars: Alex Thompson, Keith Kupferer, Katherine Mallen Kupferer, Tara Mallen
Description: Cuando un obrero de la construcción se une inesperadamente a la producción de Romeo y Julieta de un teatro local, el drama sobre el escenario empieza a reflejar su propia vida.

Title: Zolotoe dno
Stars: Yulia Snigir, Angelina Pahomova, Yuliya Frants
Description: After a billionaire's death, his family members and ex-partner vie for control of his assets, forming alliances and betrayals amid settling old scores and redistributing wealth.

Title: Tantsuy, Selyodka!
Stars: Ilya Antonenko, Bella Avanesova, Aleksandra Babaskina
Description: Zhanna returns from Moscow to the city of her childhood, having learned that her father is dying. She did not communicate with him for the last 20 years after he left his family. Zhanna does not have time to catch him alive and plans to return to Moscow immediately after organizing the funeral. But the story takes a new turn: the father's corpse comes to life. He demands to spend the last day together.

Title: Hogar, dulce hogar
Stars: Cary Grant, Betsy Drake, Lurene Tuttle
Description: Anna y Poppy Rose, se convierten en padres adoptivos de varios niños nacidos, incluida una niña de 13 años desesperadamente infeliz y un niño discapacitado físicamente con tendencia a meterse en serios problemas.

Title: Bajo terapia
Stars: Malena Alterio, Alexandra Jiménez, Fele Martínez
Description: Tres parejas son convocadas por su psicólogo para una terapia de grupo que les empuja a lavar cada vez más trapos sucios en público.

Title: La familia Savages
Stars: Laura Linney, Philip Seymour Hoffman, Philip Bosco
Description: Una hermana y un hermano se enfrentan a la realidad de las responsabilidades familiares a medida que cuidan de su padre enfermo.

Title: Opasnyy vozrast
Stars: Alisa Freyndlikh, Juozas Budraitis, Anton Tabakov
Description: The Rodimtsevs, who had been married for twenty years, suddenly discovered a complete lack of understanding. They saw divorce as the solution. But in reality, things turned out to be more complicated.

Title: Dos familias
Stars: Niamh Algar, Alban Guo
Description: Dos parejas descubren que sus hijos pequeños fueron cambiados al nacer en una confusión hospitalaria, y se enfrentan a un horrible dilema: ¿se quedan con los hijos que han criado y amado, o reclaman a su hijo biológico?

Title: Pozdniy rebyonok
Stars: Vasiliy Merkurev, Antonina Maksimova, Irina Gubanova
Description: The story is told on behalf of the boy Leni, a late child. A happy family, where the second child was expected for 16 years. Lenya's sister, architect Lyudmila, was going on a business trip with her fiance Ivan for six months, and her father (Vasily Merkuryev), this cheerful cheerful man, had a heart attack. Lena had to turn from a small, beloved boy into an adult in order to smooth out the solution of adult problems.

Title: Edinstvennaya
Stars: Valeriy Zolotukhin, Elena Proklova, Lyudmila Gladunko
Description: Young husband returns from military service, but his marriage is ruined by his increasing feelings of jealousy towards his cheerful and open-minded wife. His second marriage is no more successful, and he resorts to drinking and risks losing his job.

Title: Zhili-byli starik so starukhoy
Stars: Ivan Marin, Vera Kuznetsova, Georgiy Martynyuk
Description: The old parents are trying to arrange the life of their miserable daughter.

Title: Vzroslye deti
Stars: Aleksey Gribov, Zoya Fyodorova, Liliana Alyoshnikova
Description: The complex relationship between two generations, about how ridiculous parents are, who tirelessly watch over their overgrown children. And how frivolous can be grown children.

Title: Las visitas del presidente
Stars: Irena Malkiewicz, Beata Tyszkiewicz, Leon Niemczyk
Description: Jacek is imagining that he receives visits from "The President," a man who looks and acts just like his father before he remarried and started to ignore him. Concerned parents are now seeking psychiatric care for him due to his obsession.

Title: Amerikanskaya doch
Stars: Allison Whitbeck, Vladimir Mashkov, Mariya Shukshina
Description: A lonely Russian man is trying to see his daughter who lives with her mother far away in the USA.

Title: El minuto de la verdad
Stars: Michèle Morgan, Jean Gabin, Daniel Gélin
Description: On the night of their tenth anniversary, Doctor Pierre Richard accidentally discovers that his wife, actress Madeleine, has been having an affair with a disturbed artist, Daniel Prevost who has just attempted suicide. He confronts her and she spends the night trying to explain the reasons for her infidelity...he took their marriage for granted, he spent too much time at work, he appeared to be attracted to his pretty assistant and on and on...in two languages and some badly dubbed English. Will he buy this? Will they stay together?

Title: Leyendas de pasión
Stars: Brad Pitt, Anthony Hopkins, Aidan Quinn
Description: A principios del siglo XX, tres hermanos y su padre, que viven en los remotos parajes de Montana, se ven afectados por la traición, la historia, el amor, la naturaleza y la guerra.

Title: El violinista en el tejado
Stars: Topol, Norma Crane, Leonard Frey
Description: En la Rusia prerrevolucionaria, un campesino judío con valores tradicionales se enfrenta a casar a tres de sus hijas con ideales románticos modernos mientras el creciente sentimiento antisemita amenaza a su pueblo.

Title: Shumnyy den
Stars: Georgi Natanson, Valentina Sperantova, Gennadi Pechnikov, Tatyana Nadezhdina
Description: The main hero is an enthusiastic, kind-hearted and somewhat confused schoolboy with a love for goldfish. He lives with his family. But their serene lifestyle is somewhat disturbed by the behavior of his older brother's wife - the attractive young lady is obsessed with purchasing things.

Title: Muzhiki!
Stars: Pyotr Glebov, Vera Alkhovskaya, Aleksandr Mikhaylov
Description: The miner decides to raise the three children of the woman he loved. A poignant Soviet drama about real men.

Title: Kai
Stars: Ken Ogata, Yukiyo Toake, Yûko Natori
Description: The story of Iwago, a troubled Japanese man who has grave personal problems and strained relationships with his wife and step children.

Title: Dvoe v novom dome
Stars: Mariya Solomina, Aleksandr Abdulov, Kira Romanova

Title: Ikitai
Stars: Rentarô Mikuni, Shinobu Ôtake, Naoko Ôtani
Description: It is based on the story of The Ballad of Narayama updated to the present day, with the substitution of putting a parent into an old people's home for the abandonment of the original.

Title: Leila
Stars: Leila Hatami, Ali Mosaffa, Jamileh Sheikhi
Description: The story of a semi-modern Iranian couple, who are trying to fight the old beliefs and old generation, but is a failing battle because the man is not strong enough.

Title: Housewife, 49
Stars: Victoria Wood, David Threlfall, Christopher Harper
Description: In the late 1930s, Nella Last, a 49 year old housewife living in Barrow-in-Furness on the North West English coast, agrees to send details of her routine to the Mass Observation Project; a non-governmental scheme designed to chronicle the lives of ordinary people. When war comes, Nella defies her over-protective husband to join the local Women's Voluntary Service. Initially diffident, she blossoms thanks to the dominant but kindly Mrs. Waite, and enjoys her independence as a useful war worker. The film also shows her relationship with her two sons, as well as the effect of the war on the community, and ends by explaining that Nella kept in touch with the Mass Observation project until her death in 1968.

Title: Querido Frankie
Stars: Emily Mortimer, Jack McElhone, Gerard Butler
Description: Después de haber respondido a las numerosas cartas de su hijo haciéndose pasar por su padre, una mujer contrata a un extraño para que se haga pasar por su padre cuando lo conozca.

Title: Nunca canté para mi padre
Stars: Melvyn Douglas, Gene Hackman, Dorothy Stickney
Description: A un hombre que vive a la imponente sombra de su anciano padre le resulta difícil empezar un nuevo capítulo en su vida casándose con su novia y mudándose a California.

Title: Tryn-trava
Stars: Lidiya Fedoseeva-Shukshina, Sergey Nikonenko, Nikolay Burlyaev

Title: El gatopardo
Stars: Kim Rossi Stuart, Benedetta Porcaroli, Saul Nanni
Description: Durante el Risorgimento siciliano de 1860, el Príncipe de Salina se resiste al cambio. Su sobrino idealista Tancredi se une a los rebeldes mientras un hombre ambicioso aprovecha el tumulto.

Title: Nosotros
Stars: Saskia Reeves, Tom Taylor
Description: La conmovedora e hilarante experiencia de los Petersen durante sus vacaciones por Europa.

Title: Cómo hacerse millonario antes de que muera la abuela
Stars: Putthipong Assaratanakul, Usha Seamkhum, Sanya Kunakorn
Description: Un hombre deja el trabajo para cuidar de su abuela moribunda, motivado por su fortuna. Trata de ganarse su favor antes de que fallezca.

Title: Mignon è partita
Stars: Stefania Sandrelli, Jean-Pierre Duriez, Leonardo Ruta
Description: A French teenage girl is forced to move in with her less well off Italian relatives.

Title: Fleishman está en apuros
Stars: Claire Danes, Lizzy Caplan
Description: Toby Fleishman sabía qué esperar cuando él y su esposa de casi 15 años se separaron: tensión en sus negociaciones de crianza compartida.

Title: Viento salvaje
Stars: Anthony Quinn, Anna Magnani, Anthony Franciosa
Description: An immigrant Nevada rancher brings a woman from Italy to be his second wife, but when he neglects her she becomes involved with his trusted assistant.

Title: Istochnik
Stars: Dzidra Ritenberga, Vladimir Kashpur, Natalya Rybakova
Description: After the wedding, Savely brings his sick wife to Lake Baikal. They settle in a village near the spring and lead a quiet, measured life. She's getting better, the long, terrible days are over, but a new trouble is coming to the house.

Title: Vortex
Stars: Dario Argento, Françoise Lebrun, Alex Lutz
Description: Sigue los últimos días de una pareja de ancianos que sufre de demencia.

Title: Hermanos
Stars: Connie Nielsen, Ulrich Thomsen, Nikolaj Lie Kaas
Description: Dos hermanos deben negociar roles cambiantes y dinámicas familiares cambiantes cuando uno es enviado a la guerra en Afganistán.
